statement:
theorem measureReal_biUnion_ge_bonferroni {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι)
    (A : ι → Set Ω) (hA : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, (ℙ : Measure Ω).real (A i)

      ≤ (ℙ : Measure Ω).real (⋃ i ∈ s, A i)

      = ∑ e ∈ H.filter (fun e => v ∈ e),

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.safeDegree_expectation_ge
statement:
theorem safeDegree_expectation_ge {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (v : V) :
    ∑ e ∈ H.filter (fun e => v ∈ e), (1 - ∑ u ∈ e.erase v, coverRate H p u)
      ≤ ∫ ω, (safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ) ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.safeDegree_expectation_le
statement:
theorem safeDegree_expectation_le {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (v : V) :
    ∫ ω, (safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ) ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω)
      ≤ ∑ e ∈ H.filter (fun e => v ∈ e),
        (1 - ∑ u ∈ e.erase v, coverRate H p u
          + ∑ u ∈ e.erase v, ∑ u' ∈ (e.erase v).erase u,
              ((degree H u : ℝ) * (degree H u' : ℝ) * p ^ 2 + (codegree H u u' : ℝ) * p))

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.centered_second_moment_le
statement:
theorem centered_second_moment_le {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (v : V)
    {κ : ℕ} {qhi ε₂ : ℝ}
    (hκ : ∀ u : V, u ≠ v → codegree H v u ≤ κ)
    (hq : ∀ u : V, coverRate H p u ≤ qhi) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε₂)
    (hpair : ∀ u u' : V, u ≠ u' →
      (ℙ : Measure Ω).real ({ω | u ∈ covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)}
          ∩ {ω | u' ∈ covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)})
        - coverRate H p u * coverRate H p u' ≤ ε₂) :
    ∫ ω, (lossWeight ρ v ω - lossWeightMean H p v) ^ 2 ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω)
      ≤ (κ : ℝ) * (∑ u ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset V).erase v, (codegree H v u : ℝ)) * qhi
        + ε₂ * (∑ u ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset V).erase v, (codegree H v u : ℝ)) ^ 2

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.pair_excess_le
statement:
theorem pair_excess_le {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ} {r Δ κ : ℕ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (hr : IsUniform H r) (hΔ : ∀ y, degree H y ≤ Δ)
    (hκ : ∀ y z : V, y ≠ z → codegree H y z ≤ κ) {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    (ℙ : Measure Ω).real
        ({ω | x ∈ covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)} ∩ {ω | y ∈ covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)})
        - coverRate H p x * coverRate H p y
      ≤ 2 * (r : ℝ) * (Δ : ℝ) ^ 3 * p ^ 3 + (κ : ℝ) * p

statement:
theorem exists_tight_round {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    {t s a Vb Pb qlo : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hs : 0 < s) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hVb : ∀ v : V, ∫ ω, (lossWeight ρ v ω - lossWeightMean H p v) ^ 2 ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω) ≤ Vb)
    (hPb : ∀ v : V, ∫ ω, pairCount ρ v ω ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω) ≤ Pb)
    (hqlo1 : qlo ≤ 1) (hqlo : ∀ v : V, qlo ≤ coverRate H p v)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card V)
    (hsmall : ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) * (Vb / t ^ 2 + Pb / s)) * (2 - qlo) < a * qlo) :
    ∃ ω : Ω, ∃ B : Finset V, (B.card : ℝ) < a ∧
      (∀ v ∉ B,
        (degree H v : ℝ) - lossWeightMean H p v - t
            ≤ (safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ)
          ∧ (safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ)
            ≤ (degree H v : ℝ) - lossWeightMean H p v + t + s)
      ∧ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * qlo / 2 < ((covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)).card : ℝ)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.exists_tight_round_on
statement:
theorem exists_tight_round_on {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (G : Finset V)
    {t s a Vb Pb qlo : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hs : 0 < s) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hVb : ∀ v : V, ∫ ω, (lossWeight ρ v ω - lossWeightMean H p v) ^ 2 ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω) ≤ Vb)
    (hPb : ∀ v : V, ∫ ω, pairCount ρ v ω ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω) ≤ Pb)
    (hqlo1 : qlo ≤ 1) (hqlo : ∀ v ∈ G, qlo ≤ coverRate H p v)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card V)
    (hsmall : ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) * (Vb / t ^ 2 + Pb / s))
        * (2 * (Fintype.card V : ℝ) - (G.card : ℝ) * qlo)
      < a * ((G.card : ℝ) * qlo)) :
    ∃ ω : Ω, ∃ B : Finset V, (B.card : ℝ) < a ∧
      (∀ v ∉ B,
        (degree H v : ℝ) - lossWeightMean H p v - t
            ≤ (safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ)
          ∧ (safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ)
            ≤ (degree H v : ℝ) - lossWeightMean H p v + t + s)
      ∧ (G.card : ℝ) * qlo / 2 < ((covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)).card : ℝ)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.exists_round_explicit
statement:
theorem exists_round_explicit {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {H : Finset (Finset V)} {r Δ δ κ : ℕ} {γ θ : ℝ}
    (hr2 : 2 ≤ r) (hγ0 : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1 / 2) (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1)
    (hr : IsUniform H r) (hΔ : ∀ y : V, degree H y ≤ Δ) (hδ : ∀ y : V, δ ≤ degree H y)
    (hδ1 : 1 ≤ δ) (hΔδ : (Δ : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (δ : ℝ))
    (hκ : ∀ y z : V, y ≠ z → codegree H y z ≤ κ)
    (hκsmall : (κ : ℝ) ≤ θ * γ ^ 3 * (Δ : ℝ) / (1280 * (r : ℝ)))
    (hNbig : 512 * (r : ℝ) / γ ≤ (Fintype.card V : ℝ)) :
    ∃ R' : Finset (Finset V), R' ⊆ H ∧ ∃ B : Finset V,
      (B.card : ℝ) < θ * (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ∧
      (∀ v ∉ B, v ∉ covered R' →
        (δ : ℝ) - γ * (Δ : ℝ) - γ ^ 2 * (Δ : ℝ) ≤ (degree (Hypergraph.residual H R') v : ℝ)
          ∧ (degree (Hypergraph.residual H R') v : ℝ)
            ≤ (Δ : ℝ) - ((r : ℝ) - 1) * (δ : ℝ) * (γ / (4 * (r : ℝ)))
                + γ ^ 2 * (Δ : ℝ) + 16 * γ ^ 2 * (Δ : ℝ) / θ)
      ∧ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * γ / (8 * (r : ℝ)) < ((covered R').card : ℝ)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.exists_round_residual_band
statement:
theorem exists_round_residual_band {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ} {r Δ δ κ : ℕ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hr1 : 1 ≤ r)
    (hr : IsUniform H r) (hΔ : ∀ y : V, degree H y ≤ Δ) (hδ : ∀ y : V, δ ≤ degree H y)
    (hκ : ∀ y z : V, y ≠ z → codegree H y z ≤ κ)
    {t s a : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hs : 0 < s) (ha : 0 < a) (hN : 0 < Fintype.card V)
    (hsmall :
      ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) *
          (((κ : ℝ) * (((r : ℝ) - 1) * (Δ : ℝ)) * ((Δ : ℝ) * p)
              + ((Δ : ℝ) ^ 2 * p ^ 2 + (κ : ℝ) * p) * (((r : ℝ) - 1) * (Δ : ℝ)) ^ 2) / t ^ 2
            + ((Δ : ℝ) * ((r : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 * ((Δ : ℝ) ^ 2 * p ^ 2 + (κ : ℝ) * p)) / s))
        * (2 - (δ : ℝ) * (p * (1 - p) ^ (r * Δ)))
      < a * ((δ : ℝ) * (p * (1 - p) ^ (r * Δ)))) :
    ∃ R' : Finset (Finset V), R' ⊆ H ∧ ∃ B : Finset V, (B.card : ℝ) < a ∧
      (∀ v ∉ B, v ∉ covered R' →
        (δ : ℝ) - ((r : ℝ) - 1) * (Δ : ℝ) * ((Δ : ℝ) * p) - t
            ≤ (degree (Hypergraph.residual H R') v : ℝ)
          ∧ (degree (Hypergraph.residual H R') v : ℝ)
            ≤ (Δ : ℝ) - ((r : ℝ) - 1) * (δ : ℝ) * ((δ : ℝ) * (p * (1 - p) ^ (r * Δ)))
                + t + s)
      ∧ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * ((δ : ℝ) * (p * (1 - p) ^ (r * Δ))) / 2
          < ((covered R').card : ℝ)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.exists_round_residual_band_cheb
statement:
theorem exists_round_residual_band_cheb {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ} {r Δ δ κ : ℕ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hr1 : 1 ≤ r)
    (hr : IsUniform H r) (hΔ : ∀ y : V, degree H y ≤ Δ) (hδ : ∀ y : V, δ ≤ degree H y)
    (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hκ : ∀ y z : V, y ≠ z → codegree H y z ≤ κ)
    {t s a : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hs : 0 < s) (ha : 0 < a) (hN : 0 < Fintype.card V)
    (hsmall :
      ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) *
          (((κ : ℝ) * (((r : ℝ) - 1) * (Δ : ℝ)) * ((Δ : ℝ) * p)
              + ((κ : ℝ) * p + 4 * (r : ℝ) ^ 2 * (κ : ℝ) * (Δ : ℝ) ^ 2 * p ^ 3)
                * (((r : ℝ) - 1) * (Δ : ℝ)) ^ 2) / t ^ 2
            + ((Δ : ℝ) * ((r : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 * ((Δ : ℝ) ^ 2 * p ^ 2 + (κ : ℝ) * p)) / s)) / a
        + ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) * ((Δ : ℝ) * p)
            + (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ^ 2
              * ((κ : ℝ) * p + 4 * (r : ℝ) ^ 2 * (κ : ℝ) * (Δ : ℝ) ^ 2 * p ^ 3))
          / ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) * ((δ : ℝ) * (p * (1 - p) ^ (r * Δ))) / 2) ^ 2
        < 1) :
    ∃ R' : Finset (Finset V), R' ⊆ H ∧ ∃ B : Finset V, (B.card : ℝ) < a ∧
      (∀ v ∉ B, v ∉ covered R' →
        (δ : ℝ) - ((r : ℝ) - 1) * (Δ : ℝ) * ((Δ : ℝ) * p) - t
            ≤ (degree (Hypergraph.residual H R') v : ℝ)
          ∧ (degree (Hypergraph.residual H R') v : ℝ)
            ≤ (Δ : ℝ) - ((r : ℝ) - 1) * (δ : ℝ) * ((δ : ℝ) * (p * (1 - p) ^ (r * Δ)))
                + t + s)
      ∧ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * ((δ : ℝ) * (p * (1 - p) ^ (r * Δ))) / 2
          < ((covered R').card : ℝ)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.exists_tight_round_cheb
statement:
theorem exists_tight_round_cheb {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p)
    {t s a Vb Pb Q Cvar : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hs : 0 < s) (ha : 0 < a) (hQ : 0 < Q)
    (hVb : ∀ v : V, ∫ ω, (lossWeight ρ v ω - lossWeightMean H p v) ^ 2 ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω) ≤ Vb)
    (hPb : ∀ v : V, ∫ ω, pairCount ρ v ω ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω) ≤ Pb)
    (hmean : Q ≤ ∑ v : V, coverRate H p v)
    (hvar : ∫ ω, (((covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)).card : ℝ) - ∑ v : V, coverRate H p v) ^ 2
        ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω) ≤ Cvar)
    (hsmall : ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) * (Vb / t ^ 2 + Pb / s)) / a + Cvar / (Q / 2) ^ 2 < 1) :
    ∃ ω : Ω, ∃ B : Finset V, (B.card : ℝ) < a ∧
      (∀ v ∉ B,
        (degree H v : ℝ) - lossWeightMean H p v - t
            ≤ (safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ)
          ∧ (safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ)
            ≤ (degree H v : ℝ) - lossWeightMean H p v + t + s)
      ∧ Q / 2 < ((covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)).card : ℝ)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.exists_tight_round_cheb_of_params
statement:
theorem exists_tight_round_cheb_of_params {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ} {r Δ δ κ : ℕ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hr1 : 1 ≤ r)
    (hr : IsUniform H r) (hΔ : ∀ y : V, degree H y ≤ Δ) (hδ : ∀ y : V, δ ≤ degree H y)
    (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hκ : ∀ y z : V, y ≠ z → codegree H y z ≤ κ)
    {t s a : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hs : 0 < s) (ha : 0 < a) (hN : 0 < Fintype.card V)
    (hsmall :
      ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) *
          (((κ : ℝ) * (((r : ℝ) - 1) * (Δ : ℝ)) * ((Δ : ℝ) * p)
              + ((κ : ℝ) * p + 4 * (r : ℝ) ^ 2 * (κ : ℝ) * (Δ : ℝ) ^ 2 * p ^ 3)
                * (((r : ℝ) - 1) * (Δ : ℝ)) ^ 2) / t ^ 2
            + ((Δ : ℝ) * ((r : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 * ((Δ : ℝ) ^ 2 * p ^ 2 + (κ : ℝ) * p)) / s)) / a
        + ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) * ((Δ : ℝ) * p)
            + (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ^ 2
              * ((κ : ℝ) * p + 4 * (r : ℝ) ^ 2 * (κ : ℝ) * (Δ : ℝ) ^ 2 * p ^ 3))
          / ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) * ((δ : ℝ) * (p * (1 - p) ^ (r * Δ))) / 2) ^ 2
        < 1) :
    ∃ ω : Ω, ∃ B : Finset V, (B.card : ℝ) < a ∧
      (∀ v ∉ B,
        (degree H v : ℝ) - lossWeightMean H p v - t
            ≤ (safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ)
          ∧ (safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ)
            ≤ (degree H v : ℝ) - lossWeightMean H p v + t + s)
      ∧ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * ((δ : ℝ) * (p * (1 - p) ^ (r * Δ))) / 2
          < ((covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)).card : ℝ)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.exists_tight_round_of_params
statement:
theorem exists_tight_round_of_params {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ} {r Δ δ κ : ℕ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hr1 : 1 ≤ r)
    (hr : IsUniform H r) (hΔ : ∀ y : V, degree H y ≤ Δ) (hδ : ∀ y : V, δ ≤ degree H y)
    (hκ : ∀ y z : V, y ≠ z → codegree H y z ≤ κ)
    {t s a : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hs : 0 < s) (ha : 0 < a) (hN : 0 < Fintype.card V)
    (hsmall :
      ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) *
          (((κ : ℝ) * (((r : ℝ) - 1) * (Δ : ℝ)) * ((Δ : ℝ) * p)
              + ((Δ : ℝ) ^ 2 * p ^ 2 + (κ : ℝ) * p) * (((r : ℝ) - 1) * (Δ : ℝ)) ^ 2) / t ^ 2
            + ((Δ : ℝ) * ((r : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 * ((Δ : ℝ) ^ 2 * p ^ 2 + (κ : ℝ) * p)) / s))
        * (2 - (δ : ℝ) * (p * (1 - p) ^ (r * Δ)))
      < a * ((δ : ℝ) * (p * (1 - p) ^ (r * Δ)))) :
    ∃ ω : Ω, ∃ B : Finset V, (B.card : ℝ) < a ∧
      (∀ v ∉ B,
        (degree H v : ℝ) - lossWeightMean H p v - t
            ≤ (safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ)
          ∧ (safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ)
            ≤ (degree H v : ℝ) - lossWeightMean H p v + t + s)
      ∧ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * ((δ : ℝ) * (p * (1 - p) ^ (r * Δ))) / 2
          < ((covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)).card : ℝ)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.integral_pairCount_le_params
statement:
theorem integral_pairCount_le_params {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ} {r Δ κ : ℕ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hr1 : 1 ≤ r)
    (hr : IsUniform H r) (hΔ : ∀ y : V, degree H y ≤ Δ)
    (hκ : ∀ y z : V, y ≠ z → codegree H y z ≤ κ) (v : V) :
    ∫ ω, pairCount ρ v ω ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω)
      ≤ (Δ : ℝ) * ((r : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 * ((Δ : ℝ) ^ 2 * p ^ 2 + (κ : ℝ) * p)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.lossWeightMean_ge
LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.lossWeightMean_le
LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.prob_two_covered_le_params
statement:
theorem prob_two_covered_le_params {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ} {Δ κ : ℕ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p)
    (hΔ : ∀ y : V, degree H y ≤ Δ) (hκ : ∀ y z : V, y ≠ z → codegree H y z ≤ κ)
    (u u' : V) (huu' : u ≠ u') :
    (ℙ : Measure Ω).real
        ({ω | u ∈ covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)} ∩ {ω | u' ∈ covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)})
      ≤ (Δ : ℝ) ^ 2 * p ^ 2 + (κ : ℝ) * p

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.safeDegree_band_of_tolerances
statement:
theorem safeDegree_band_of_tolerances {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (v : V) (ω : Ω) {t s : ℝ}
    (hloss : |lossWeight ρ v ω - lossWeightMean H p v| < t)
    (hpair : pairCount ρ v ω < s) :
    (degree H v : ℝ) - lossWeightMean H p v - t
        ≤ (safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ)
      ∧ (safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ)
        ≤ (degree H v : ℝ) - lossWeightMean H p v + t + s

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.D_avgL_comm
statement:
theorem D_avgL_comm {i : ι} {l : List ι} (hi : i ∉ l) (p : ℝ) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    D i (avgL p l f) = avgL p l (D i f)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.D_avgOne_comm
statement:
theorem D_avgOne_comm {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (p : ℝ) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    D i (avgOne p j f) = avgOne p j (D i f)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.D_update
statement:
theorem D_update (i : ι) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (ω : ι → Bool) (b : Bool) :
    D i f (Function.update ω i b) = D i f ω

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.Exp_add
statement:
theorem Exp_add (p : ℝ) (f g : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    Exp p (fun ω => f ω + g ω) = Exp p f + Exp p g

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.Exp_avgL
statement: theorem Exp_avgL (p : ℝ) (l : List ι) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) : Exp p (avgL p l f) = Exp p f

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.Exp_avgOne
statement:
theorem Exp_avgOne (p : ℝ) (i : ι) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    Exp p (avgOne p i f) = Exp p f

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.Exp_centred_sq
statement:
theorem Exp_centred_sq (p : ℝ) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    Exp p (fun ω => (f ω - Exp p f) ^ 2) = Exp p (fun ω => f ω ^ 2) - (Exp p f) ^ 2

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.Exp_const
statement: theorem Exp_const (p : ℝ) (c : ℝ) : Exp p (fun _ : ι → Bool => c) = c

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.Exp_coord_mul
statement:
theorem Exp_coord_mul {p : ℝ} (f g : ι) :
    Exp p (fun ω : ι → Bool =>
        (if ω f then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * (if ω g then (1 : ℝ) else 0))
      = if f = g then p else p ^ 2

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.Exp_finset_sum
statement:
theorem Exp_finset_sum {α : Type*} (p : ℝ) (s : Finset α) (g : α → (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    Exp p (fun ω => ∑ a ∈ s, g a ω) = ∑ a ∈ s, Exp p (g a)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.Exp_indicator_biInter
statement:
theorem Exp_indicator_biInter (p : ℝ) (S : Finset ι) :
    Exp p (fun ω => Set.indicator (⋂ e ∈ S, {ω : ι → Bool | ω e = true}) 1 ω) = p ^ S.card

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.Exp_mono
statement:
theorem Exp_mono {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) {f g : (ι → Bool) → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ ω, f ω ≤ g ω) : Exp p f ≤ Exp p g

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.Exp_nonneg
statement:
theorem Exp_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) {f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω) : 0 ≤ Exp p f

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.Exp_prod
statement:
theorem Exp_prod (p : ℝ) (g : ι → Bool → ℝ) :
    Exp p (fun ω => ∏ i, g i (ω i)) = ∏ i, (p * g i true + (1 - p) * g i false)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.Exp_smul
statement:
theorem Exp_smul (p c : ℝ) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    Exp p (fun ω => c * f ω) = c * Exp p f

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.Exp_split
statement:
theorem Exp_split (p : ℝ) (i : ι) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    Exp p f = ∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : ι → Bool => ω i = false),
      wtc i p ω * ((1 - p) * f ω + p * f (Function.update ω i true))

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.Exp_sq_avgL_le
statement:
theorem Exp_sq_avgL_le {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (l : List ι) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    Exp p (fun ω => avgL p l f ω ^ 2) ≤ Exp p (fun ω => f ω ^ 2)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.Exp_sq_avgOne_le
statement:
theorem Exp_sq_avgOne_le {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (i : ι) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    Exp p (fun ω => avgOne p i f ω ^ 2) ≤ Exp p (fun ω => f ω ^ 2)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.Exp_sq_sub_avgOne
statement:
theorem Exp_sq_sub_avgOne (p : ℝ) (i : ι) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    Exp p (fun ω => f ω ^ 2) - Exp p (fun ω => avgOne p i f ω ^ 2)
      = p * (1 - p) * Exp p (fun ω => D i f ω ^ 2)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.Exp_weighted_sum_sq_le
statement:
theorem Exp_weighted_sum_sq_le {p : ℝ} (M : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) :
    Exp p (fun ω : ι → Bool => (∑ f ∈ M, if ω f then w f else 0) ^ 2)
      ≤ p * (∑ f ∈ M, w f ^ 2) + p ^ 2 * (∑ f ∈ M, w f) ^ 2

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.avgL_congr
statement:
theorem avgL_congr (p : ℝ) (l : List ι) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) {ω ω' : ι → Bool}
    (h : ∀ j, j ∉ l → ω j = ω' j) : avgL p l f ω = avgL p l f ω'

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.avgOne_update
statement:
theorem avgOne_update (p : ℝ) (i : ι) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (ω : ι → Bool) (b : Bool) :
    avgOne p i f (Function.update ω i b) = avgOne p i f ω

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.centred_sq_le_sum_sq_diff
statement:
theorem centred_sq_le_sum_sq_diff {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    Exp p (fun ω => (f ω - Exp p f) ^ 2)
      ≤ ∑ i : ι, p * (1 - p) * Exp p (fun ω => D i f ω ^ 2)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.cubeMeasure_apply
statement:
theorem cubeMeasure_apply {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (A : Set (ι → Bool)) :
    cubeMeasure p A = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ ω, wt p ω * Set.indicator A 1 ω)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.cubeMeasure_biInter
statement:
theorem cubeMeasure_biInter {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (S : Finset ι) :
    cubeMeasure p (⋂ e ∈ S, {ω : ι → Bool | ω e = true}) = ENNReal.ofReal (p ^ S.card)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.cubeMeasure_coord
statement:
theorem cubeMeasure_coord {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (e : ι) :
    cubeMeasure p {ω : ι → Bool | ω e = true} = ENNReal.ofReal p

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.cube_centred_sq_le
statement:
theorem cube_centred_sq_le {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    ∫ ω, (f ω - ∫ ω', f ω' ∂(cubeMeasure p)) ^ 2 ∂(cubeMeasure p)
      ≤ ∑ i : ι, p * (1 - p)
          * ∫ ω, (f (Function.update ω i true) - f (Function.update ω i false)) ^ 2
              ∂(cubeMeasure p)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.iIndepSet_cubeCoord
statement:
theorem iIndepSet_cubeCoord {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    iIndepSet (fun e : ι => {ω : ι → Bool | ω e = true}) (cubeMeasure p)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.indicator_biInter_eq
statement:
theorem indicator_biInter_eq (S : Finset ι) (ω : ι → Bool) :
    Set.indicator (⋂ e ∈ S, {ω : ι → Bool | ω e = true}) 1 ω
      = ∏ i, (if i ∈ S then (if ω i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) else 1)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.integral_cubeMeasure
statement:
theorem integral_cubeMeasure {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    ∫ ω, f ω ∂(cubeMeasure p) = Exp p f

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.isProbabilityMeasure_cubeMeasure
statement:
theorem isProbabilityMeasure_cubeMeasure {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (cubeMeasure (ι := ι) p)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.sum_split
statement:
theorem sum_split (i : ι) (g : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    ∑ ω : ι → Bool, g ω
      = ∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : ι → Bool => ω i = false),
          (g ω + g (Function.update ω i true))

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.sum_wt
statement: theorem sum_wt {p : ℝ} : ∑ ω : ι → Bool, wt p ω = 1

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.variance_le_of_list
statement:
theorem variance_le_of_list {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (l : List ι) (hl : l.Nodup)
    (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    Exp p (fun ω => f ω ^ 2) - Exp p (fun ω => avgL p l f ω ^ 2)
      ≤ (l.map (fun i => p * (1 - p) * Exp p (fun ω => D i f ω ^ 2))).sum

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.variance_le_sum_sq_diff
statement:
theorem variance_le_sum_sq_diff {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    Exp p (fun ω => f ω ^ 2) - (Exp p f) ^ 2
      ≤ ∑ i : ι, p * (1 - p) * Exp p (fun ω => D i f ω ^ 2)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.wt_eq
statement:
theorem wt_eq (i : ι) (p : ℝ) (ω : ι → Bool) :
    wt p ω = (if ω i then p else 1 - p) * wtc i p ω

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.wt_nonneg
statement: theorem wt_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (ω : ι → Bool) : 0 ≤ wt p ω

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.wtc_nonneg
statement: theorem wtc_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (i : ι) (ω : ι → Bool) : 0 ≤ wtc i p ω

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Cube.wtc_update
statement:
theorem wtc_update (i : ι) (p : ℝ) (ω : ι → Bool) (b : Bool) :
    wtc i p (Function.update ω i b) = wtc i p ω

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.D_safeDegCube_of_notMem
statement:
theorem D_safeDegCube_of_notMem {H : Finset (Finset V)} {k : Finset V} (hk : k ∉ H) (v : V)
    (ω : Finset V → Bool) : Cube.D k (safeDegCube H v) ω = 0

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Exp_flipWeight_sq_le
statement:
theorem Exp_flipWeight_sq_le {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ} (v : V) (k : Finset V) :
    Cube.Exp p (fun ω => flipWeight H v k ω ^ 2)
      ≤ p * (∑ f ∈ meets H k, edgeWeight H v f ^ 2)
        + p ^ 2 * (∑ f ∈ meets H k, edgeWeight H v f) ^ 2

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Exp_safeDegCube_ge
statement:
theorem Exp_safeDegCube_ge {K : Finset (Finset V)} {r Δ : ℕ} {p : ℝ}
    (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hr1 : 1 ≤ r) (hr : IsUniform K r)
    (hΔ : ∀ y : V, degree K y ≤ Δ) (v : V) :
    (degree K v : ℝ) * (1 - ((r : ℝ) - 1) * ((Δ : ℝ) * p)) ≤ Cube.Exp p (safeDegCube K v)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.Exp_safeDegCube_le
statement:
theorem Exp_safeDegCube_le {K : Finset (Finset V)} (A : Finset V) {r Δ δ κ : ℕ} {p : ℝ}
    (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hr2 : 2 ≤ r) (hr : IsUniform K r)
    (hΔ : ∀ y : V, degree K y ≤ Δ) (hδA : ∀ y ∈ A, δ ≤ degree K y)
    (hκ : ∀ y z : V, y ≠ z → codegree K y z ≤ κ) (v : V) :
    Cube.Exp p (safeDegCube K v)
      ≤ (degree K v : ℝ)
        - ((degree K v : ℝ) - (lostDegree K Aᶜ v : ℝ))
            * (((r : ℝ) - 1) * (δ : ℝ) * (p * (1 - p) ^ (r * Δ)))
        + (degree K v : ℝ) * (((r : ℝ) - 1) * ((r : ℝ) - 2))
            * ((Δ : ℝ) ^ 2 * p ^ 2 + (κ : ℝ) * p)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.abs_D_safeDegCube_le
statement:
theorem abs_D_safeDegCube_le (H : Finset (Finset V)) (v : V) (k : Finset V)
    (ω : Finset V → Bool) :
    |Cube.D k (safeDegCube H v) ω| ≤ edgeWeight H v k + flipWeight H v k ω

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.abs_safeDegree_flip_le
statement:
theorem abs_safeDegree_flip_le (H : Finset (Finset V)) (R : Finset (Finset V))
    (e : Finset V) (v : V) :
    ((safeDegree H (covered (insert e R)) v : ℤ)
        - (safeDegree H (covered (R.erase e)) v : ℤ)).natAbs
      ≤ ∑ u ∈ (((flipInfluence R e).biUnion id).erase v), codegree H v u

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.abs_safeDegree_sub_le_card_meeting
statement:
theorem abs_safeDegree_sub_le_card_meeting {H : Finset (Finset V)} {C C' D : Finset V} {v : V}
    (hCC' : C \ C' ⊆ D) (hC'C : C' \ C ⊆ D) :
    ((safeDegree H C v : ℤ) - (safeDegree H C' v : ℤ)).natAbs
      ≤ (H.filter (fun e => v ∈ e ∧ ¬ Disjoint (e.erase v) D)).card

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.abs_safeDegree_sub_le_codegree_sum
statement:
theorem abs_safeDegree_sub_le_codegree_sum {H : Finset (Finset V)} {C C' D : Finset V}
    {v : V} (hCC' : C \ C' ⊆ D) (hC'C : C' \ C ⊆ D) :
    ((safeDegree H C v : ℤ) - (safeDegree H C' v : ℤ)).natAbs
      ≤ ∑ u ∈ D.erase v, codegree H v u

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.card_biUnion_flipInfluence_le
statement:
theorem card_biUnion_flipInfluence_le {H : Finset (Finset V)} {r : ℕ} (hunif : IsUniform H r)
    {R : Finset (Finset V)} (hRH : R ⊆ H) {e : Finset V} (he : e ∈ H) :
    ((flipInfluence R e).biUnion id).card
      ≤ r * (1 + (R.filter (fun f => ¬ Disjoint f e)).card)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.card_meeting_le_codegree_sum
statement:
theorem card_meeting_le_codegree_sum {H : Finset (Finset V)} {D : Finset V} {v : V} :
    (H.filter (fun e => v ∈ e ∧ ¬ Disjoint (e.erase v) D)).card
      ≤ ∑ u ∈ D.erase v, codegree H v u

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.card_meets_le
statement:
theorem card_meets_le {H : Finset (Finset V)} {r Δ : ℕ} (hr : IsUniform H r)
    (hΔ : ∀ y : V, degree H y ≤ Δ) {k : Finset V} (hk : k ∈ H) :
    ((meets H k).card : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ) * (Δ : ℝ)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.card_safeBadSet_le
statement:
theorem card_safeBadSet_le {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ω : Ω) :
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun v : V =>
        t ≤ |(safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ) - safeDegMean ρ v|)).card : ℝ)
      ≤ safeBad ρ t ω

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.covered_erase_sdiff_subset
statement:
theorem covered_erase_sdiff_subset (R : Finset (Finset V)) (e : Finset V) :
    covered (R.erase e) \ covered (insert e R) ⊆ (flipInfluence R e).biUnion id

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.covered_insert_sdiff_subset
statement:
theorem covered_insert_sdiff_subset (R : Finset (Finset V)) (e : Finset V) :
    covered (insert e R) \ covered (R.erase e) ⊆ (flipInfluence R e).biUnion id

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.edgeWeight_le_of_mem
statement:
theorem edgeWeight_le_of_mem {H : Finset (Finset V)} {r κ : ℕ} (hr : IsUniform H r)
    (hκ : ∀ y z : V, y ≠ z → codegree H y z ≤ κ) (v : V) {f : Finset V} (hf : f ∈ H) :
    edgeWeight H v f ≤ (r : ℝ) * (κ : ℝ)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.edgeWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem edgeWeight_nonneg (H : Finset (Finset V)) (v : V) (f : Finset V) :
    0 ≤ edgeWeight H v f

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.exists_safe_round_cheb
statement:
theorem exists_safe_round_cheb {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p)
    {t a Q Vs Cvar : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ha : 0 < a) (hQ : 0 < Q)
    (hVs : ∀ v : V, ∫ ω, ((safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ) - safeDegMean ρ v) ^ 2
        ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω) ≤ Vs)
    (hmean : Q ≤ ∑ v : V, coverRate H p v)
    (hvar : ∫ ω, (((covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)).card : ℝ) - ∑ v : V, coverRate H p v) ^ 2
        ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω) ≤ Cvar)
    (hsmall : ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) * (Vs / t ^ 2)) / a + Cvar / (Q / 2) ^ 2 < 1) :
    ∃ ω : Ω, ∃ B : Finset V, (B.card : ℝ) < a ∧
      (∀ v ∉ B,
        |(safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ) - safeDegMean ρ v| < t)
      ∧ Q / 2 < ((covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)).card : ℝ)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.exists_sharp_round_band
statement:
theorem exists_sharp_round_band {K : Finset (Finset V)} (A : Finset V) {r Δ δ κ : ℕ}
    {p t a mlo : ℝ} {mhi : V → ℝ}
    (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hr1 : 1 ≤ r) (hr : IsUniform K r)
    (hΔ : ∀ y : V, degree K y ≤ Δ) (hδA : ∀ y ∈ A, δ ≤ degree K y)
    (hκ : ∀ y z : V, y ≠ z → codegree K y z ≤ κ)
    (ht : 0 < t) (ha : 0 < a) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hA : 0 < A.card)
    (hlo : ∀ v ∈ A, mlo ≤ Cube.Exp p (safeDegCube K v))
    (hhi : ∀ v ∈ A, Cube.Exp p (safeDegCube K v) ≤ mhi v)
    (hsmall :
      ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) *
          ((2 * p * ((r : ℝ) ^ 2 * (κ : ℝ) * (Δ : ℝ) ^ 2)
            * (1 + p * (r : ℝ) * (Δ : ℝ) + (p * (r : ℝ) * (Δ : ℝ)) ^ 2)) / t ^ 2)) / a
        + ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) * ((Δ : ℝ) * p)
            + (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ^ 2
              * ((κ : ℝ) * p + 4 * (r : ℝ) ^ 2 * (κ : ℝ) * (Δ : ℝ) ^ 2 * p ^ 3))
          / ((A.card : ℝ) * ((δ : ℝ) * (p * (1 - p) ^ (r * Δ))) / 2) ^ 2 < 1) :
    ∃ R' : Finset (Finset V), R' ⊆ K ∧ ∃ B : Finset V, (B.card : ℝ) < a ∧
      (∀ v ∈ A, v ∉ B → v ∉ covered R' →
        mlo - t ≤ (degree (Hypergraph.residual K R') v : ℝ)
        ∧ (degree (Hypergraph.residual K R') v : ℝ) ≤ mhi v + t) ∧
      (A.card : ℝ) * ((δ : ℝ) * (p * (1 - p) ^ (r * Δ))) / 2 < ((covered R').card : ℝ)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.flipWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem flipWeight_nonneg (H : Finset (Finset V)) (v : V) (k : Finset V) (ω : Finset V → Bool) :
    0 ≤ flipWeight H v k ω

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.integrable_safeBad
LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.integrable_safeIndicator_mul
LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.integrable_sq_centered_safeDegree
statement:
theorem integrable_sq_centered_safeDegree {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (v : V) :
    Integrable (fun ω =>
        ((safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ) - safeDegMean ρ v) ^ 2)
      (ℙ : Measure Ω)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.integral_centered_safeDegree_cube_le
statement:
theorem integral_centered_safeDegree_cube_le
    (K : Finset (Finset V)) {r Δ κ : ℕ} {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (hr : IsUniform K r) (hΔ : ∀ y : V, degree K y ≤ Δ)
    (hκ : ∀ y z : V, y ≠ z → codegree K y z ≤ κ) (v : V) :
    ∫ ω, ((safeDegree K (covered (@retainedSet V _ (Finset V → Bool) (Cube.cubeSpace p) K p
              (cubeRetention K hp0 hp1) ω)) v : ℝ)
        - @safeDegMean V _ (Finset V → Bool) (Cube.cubeSpace p) K p (cubeRetention K hp0 hp1) v) ^ 2
        ∂(Cube.cubeMeasure p)
      ≤ 2 * p * ((r : ℝ) ^ 2 * (κ : ℝ) * (Δ : ℝ) ^ 2)
          * (1 + p * (r : ℝ) * (Δ : ℝ) + (p * (r : ℝ) * (Δ : ℝ)) ^ 2)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.integral_safeBad_le
statement:
theorem integral_safeBad_le {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) {t Vs : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    (hVs : ∀ v : V, ∫ ω, ((safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ) - safeDegMean ρ v) ^ 2
        ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω) ≤ Vs) :
    ∫ ω, safeBad ρ t ω ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω) ≤ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * (Vs / t ^ 2)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.integral_safeDegree_eq
statement:
theorem integral_safeDegree_eq {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (v : V) :
    ∫ ω, (safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ) ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω)
      = safeDegMean ρ v

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.integral_safeIndicator_mul
statement:
theorem integral_safeIndicator_mul {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (v : V) (e e' : Finset V) :
    ∫ ω, safeIndicator ρ v e ω * safeIndicator ρ v e' ω ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω)
      = 1 - (ℙ : Measure Ω).real (⋃ u ∈ e.erase v, {ω | u ∈ covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)})
        - (ℙ : Measure Ω).real (⋃ u ∈ e'.erase v, {ω | u ∈ covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)})
        + (ℙ : Measure Ω).real
            ((⋃ u ∈ e.erase v, {ω | u ∈ covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)})
              ∩ (⋃ u ∈ e'.erase v, {ω | u ∈ covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)}))

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.integral_sq_centered_safeDegree
statement:
theorem integral_sq_centered_safeDegree {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (v : V) :
    ∫ ω, ((safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ) - safeDegMean ρ v) ^ 2
        ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω)
      = ∑ e ∈ H.filter (fun e => v ∈ e), ∑ e' ∈ H.filter (fun e => v ∈ e),
          (∫ ω, safeIndicator ρ v e ω * safeIndicator ρ v e' ω ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω)
            - (∫ ω, safeIndicator ρ v e ω ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω))
              * (∫ ω, safeIndicator ρ v e' ω ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω)))

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.lostDegree_le_degree
statement:
theorem lostDegree_le_degree (K : Finset (Finset V)) (B : Finset V) (v : V) :
    lostDegree K B v ≤ degree K v

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.measureReal_inter_biUnion_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_inter_biUnion_le {ι ι' : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset ι')
    (f : ι → Set Ω) (g : ι' → Set Ω) :
    (ℙ : Measure Ω).real ((⋃ i ∈ s, f i) ∩ (⋃ j ∈ t, g j))
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ t, (ℙ : Measure Ω).real (f i ∩ g j)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.meets_comm
statement:
theorem meets_comm (H : Finset (Finset V)) (f : Finset V) :
    meets H f = H.filter (fun k => ¬ Disjoint f k)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.mem_roundMatching_insert_iff_erase
LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.notMem_flipInfluence_disjoint
statement:
theorem notMem_flipInfluence_disjoint {R : Finset (Finset V)} {e f : Finset V}
    (hf : f ∉ flipInfluence R e) (hfR : f ∈ R) : Disjoint f e

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.notMem_flipInfluence_ne
statement:
theorem notMem_flipInfluence_ne {R : Finset (Finset V)} {e f : Finset V}
    (hf : f ∉ flipInfluence R e) : f ≠ e

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.one_sub_pow_le_quadratic
statement:
theorem one_sub_pow_le_quadratic {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (m : ℕ) :
    (1 - p) ^ m ≤ 1 - (m : ℝ) * p + ((m : ℝ) * p) ^ 2 / 2

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.retSet_update_false
statement:
theorem retSet_update_false (H : Finset (Finset V)) (k : Finset V) (ω : Finset V → Bool) :
    retSet H (Function.update ω k false) = (retSet H ω).erase k

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.retSet_update_of_notMem
statement:
theorem retSet_update_of_notMem {H : Finset (Finset V)} {k : Finset V} (hk : k ∉ H)
    (ω : Finset V → Bool) (b : Bool) : retSet H (Function.update ω k b) = retSet H ω

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.retSet_update_true
statement:
theorem retSet_update_true {H : Finset (Finset V)} {k : Finset V} (hk : k ∈ H)
    (ω : Finset V → Bool) : retSet H (Function.update ω k true) = insert k (retSet H ω)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.retainedSet_cubeRetention
statement:
theorem retainedSet_cubeRetention (H : Finset (Finset V)) {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (ω : Finset V → Bool) :
    @retainedSet V _ (Finset V → Bool) (cubeSpace p) H p (cubeRetention H hp0 hp1) ω
      = H.filter (fun e => ω e = true)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.safeBad_nonneg
statement:
theorem safeBad_nonneg {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (t : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : 0 ≤ safeBad ρ t ω

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.safeDegCube_variance_le
statement:
theorem safeDegCube_variance_le {H : Finset (Finset V)} {r Δ κ : ℕ} {p : ℝ}
    (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hr : IsUniform H r) (hΔ : ∀ y : V, degree H y ≤ Δ)
    (hκ : ∀ y z : V, y ≠ z → codegree H y z ≤ κ) (v : V) :
    Cube.Exp p (fun ω => (safeDegCube H v ω - Cube.Exp p (safeDegCube H v)) ^ 2)
      ≤ 2 * p * ((r : ℝ) ^ 2 * (κ : ℝ) * (Δ : ℝ) ^ 2)
          * (1 + p * (r : ℝ) * (Δ : ℝ) + (p * (r : ℝ) * (Δ : ℝ)) ^ 2)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.safeDegMean_cubeRetention
statement:
theorem safeDegMean_cubeRetention (K : Finset (Finset V)) {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (v : V) :
    @safeDegMean V _ (Finset V → Bool) (Cube.cubeSpace p) K p (cubeRetention K hp0 hp1) v
      = Cube.Exp p (safeDegCube K v)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.safeDegree_sub_mean_eq
statement:
theorem safeDegree_sub_mean_eq {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (v : V) (ω : Ω) :
    (safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ) - safeDegMean ρ v
      = ∑ e ∈ H.filter (fun e => v ∈ e),
          (safeIndicator ρ v e ω - ∫ ω', safeIndicator ρ v e ω' ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω))

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.safeDegree_variance_le
statement:
theorem safeDegree_variance_le {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (v : V)
    {Δ n : ℕ} {qhi ε₂ Ksum : ℝ}
    (hq : ∀ u : V, coverRate H p u ≤ qhi) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε₂)
    (hpair : ∀ u u' : V, u ≠ u' →
      (ℙ : Measure Ω).real ({ω | u ∈ covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)}
          ∩ {ω | u' ∈ covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)})
        - coverRate H p u * coverRate H p u' ≤ ε₂)
    (hdeg : (H.filter (fun e => v ∈ e)).card ≤ Δ)
    (hcard : ∀ e ∈ H.filter (fun e => v ∈ e), (e.erase v).card ≤ n)
    (hK : ∑ e ∈ H.filter (fun e => v ∈ e), ∑ e' ∈ H.filter (fun e => v ∈ e),
            (((e ∩ e').erase v).card : ℝ) ≤ Ksum) :
    ∫ ω, ((safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ) - safeDegMean ρ v) ^ 2
        ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω)
      ≤ (Δ : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 * ε₂
            + 2 * ((n : ℝ) * qhi) * ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (qhi ^ 2 + ε₂)))
        + Ksum * qhi

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.safeDegree_variance_le_codegree
statement:
theorem safeDegree_variance_le_codegree {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (v : V)
    {Δ n κ : ℕ} {qhi ε₂ : ℝ}
    (hq : ∀ u : V, coverRate H p u ≤ qhi) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε₂)
    (hpair : ∀ u u' : V, u ≠ u' →
      (ℙ : Measure Ω).real ({ω | u ∈ covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)}
          ∩ {ω | u' ∈ covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)})
        - coverRate H p u * coverRate H p u' ≤ ε₂)
    (hdeg : (H.filter (fun e => v ∈ e)).card ≤ Δ)
    (hcard : ∀ e ∈ H.filter (fun e => v ∈ e), (e.erase v).card ≤ n)
    (hκ : ∀ u : V, u ≠ v → codegree H v u ≤ κ) :
    ∫ ω, ((safeDegree H (covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)) v : ℝ) - safeDegMean ρ v) ^ 2
        ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω)
      ≤ (Δ : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 * ε₂
            + 2 * ((n : ℝ) * qhi) * ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (qhi ^ 2 + ε₂)))
        + (Δ : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) * (κ : ℝ) * qhi

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.safeIndicator_covariance_eq
statement:
theorem safeIndicator_covariance_eq {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (v : V) (e e' : Finset V) :
    ∫ ω, safeIndicator ρ v e ω * safeIndicator ρ v e' ω ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω)
        - (∫ ω, safeIndicator ρ v e ω ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω))
          * (∫ ω, safeIndicator ρ v e' ω ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω))
      = (ℙ : Measure Ω).real
            ((⋃ u ∈ e.erase v, {ω | u ∈ covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)})
              ∩ (⋃ u ∈ e'.erase v, {ω | u ∈ covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)}))
        - (ℙ : Measure Ω).real (⋃ u ∈ e.erase v, {ω | u ∈ covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)})
          * (ℙ : Measure Ω).real (⋃ u ∈ e'.erase v, {ω | u ∈ covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)})

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.safeIndicator_covariance_le
statement:
theorem safeIndicator_covariance_le {H : Finset (Finset V)} {p : ℝ}
    (ρ : BernoulliRetention (Ω := Ω) H p) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (v : V) (e e' : Finset V)
    {n : ℕ} {qhi ε₂ : ℝ}
    (hq : ∀ u : V, coverRate H p u ≤ qhi) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε₂)
    (hpair : ∀ u u' : V, u ≠ u' →
      (ℙ : Measure Ω).real ({ω | u ∈ covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)}
          ∩ {ω | u' ∈ covered (retainedSet H ρ ω)})
        - coverRate H p u * coverRate H p u' ≤ ε₂)
    (hn : (e.erase v).card ≤ n) (hn' : (e'.erase v).card ≤ n) :
    ∫ ω, safeIndicator ρ v e ω * safeIndicator ρ v e' ω ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω)
        - (∫ ω, safeIndicator ρ v e ω ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω))
          * (∫ ω, safeIndicator ρ v e' ω ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω))
      ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * ε₂ + (((e ∩ e').erase v).card : ℝ) * qhi
        + 2 * ((n : ℝ) * qhi) * ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (qhi ^ 2 + ε₂))

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.safeIndicator_mul_eq
LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.sharpRoundFor_of_two_gamma_le_eps
statement:
theorem sharpRoundFor_of_two_gamma_le_eps (r : ℕ) (hr2 : 2 ≤ r) (γ ε θ α : ℝ)
    (hγ0 : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1 / 2) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) (hγε : 2 * γ ≤ ε)
    (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) :
    SharpRoundFor r γ ε θ α (256 * r / (α ^ 2 * γ) + 96 / ε + 4)
      (θ * ε ^ 2 * γ * α ^ 2 / (16384 * r))

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.sharpRoundHyp_of_gamma_le_eps
statement:
theorem sharpRoundHyp_of_gamma_le_eps (r : ℕ) (hr2 : 2 ≤ r) (γ ε θ α : ℝ)
    (hγ0 : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1 / 2) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) (hγε : 8 * γ ≤ ε)
    (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) :
    ∃ D₀ : ℝ, 0 < D₀ ∧ ∃ c₀ : ℝ, 0 < c₀ ∧ SharpRoundFor r γ ε θ α D₀ c₀

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.sharpRoundHyp_of_two_gamma_le_eps
statement:
theorem sharpRoundHyp_of_two_gamma_le_eps (r : ℕ) (hr2 : 2 ≤ r) (γ ε θ α : ℝ)
    (hγ0 : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1 / 2) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) (hγε : 2 * γ ≤ ε)
    (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) :

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.sharp_bonferroni_error_le
statement:
theorem sharp_bonferroni_error_le {rr γ Δ Dn kn p Err : ℝ} (hR2 : 2 ≤ rr) (hDn0 : 0 ≤ Dn)
    (hkn0 : 0 ≤ kn) (hp0 : 0 < p) (hpγ : rr * Dn * p = γ) (hDn_le : Dn ≤ Δ)
    (hErrdef : Err = Dn * ((rr - 1) * (rr - 2)) * (Dn ^ 2 * p ^ 2 + kn * p)) :
    Err ≤ Δ * γ ^ 2 + rr * kn * γ

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.sharp_ceiling_clause_arith
statement:
theorem sharp_ceiling_clause_arith {S γ ε δ dn Δ Dn l c d Err t x e : ℝ}
    (hSnn : 0 ≤ S) (hS1 : S ≤ 1) (hγ0 : 0 < γ) (hΔ0 : 0 < Δ) (hδ2 : 2 ≤ δ) (hδdn : δ ≤ dn)
    (hlΔ : l ≤ Δ) (hcd : c ≤ d) (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hΔc : Δ * c = δ * (1 - γ))
    (hΔd : Δ * d ≤ δ * (1 - γ) + γ ^ 2 * Δ + 3) (hDn_le : Dn ≤ Δ)
    (hb2 : x ≤ Dn - S * γ * ((dn - l) * d) + Err + t)
    (hErrle : Err ≤ Δ * γ ^ 2 + e) (ht2 : t ≤ ε * γ * Δ / 16) (hg2 : Δ * γ ^ 2 ≤ ε * γ * Δ / 2)
    (hg3 : γ * (γ ^ 2 * Δ) ≤ ε * γ * Δ / 4) (hg4 : 3 * γ ≤ ε * γ * Δ / 32)
    (he : e ≤ ε * γ * Δ / 32) (hεγΔ : 0 ≤ ε * γ * Δ) :
    x ≤ Δ - S * γ * ((δ - l) * c) + ε * γ * Δ

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.sharp_codegree_tolerance_le
statement:
theorem sharp_codegree_tolerance_le {rr γ ε θ α Δ Dn kn : ℝ} (hR0 : 0 < rr) (hγ0 : 0 < γ)
    (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1 / 2) (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1) (hα0 : 0 < α)
    (hα1 : α ≤ 1) (hDn0 : 0 ≤ Dn) (hDn_le : Dn ≤ Δ)
    (hkn3 : kn ≤ θ * ε ^ 2 * γ * α ^ 2 * Dn / (8192 * rr)) :
    rr * kn * γ ≤ ε * γ * Δ / 32

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.sharp_cover_rate_le
statement:
theorem sharp_cover_rate_le {rr γ Dn dn p L : ℝ} (hR0 : 0 < rr) (hDn0 : 0 < Dn)
    (hdnhalf : Dn / 2 ≤ dn) (hLhalf : 1 / 2 ≤ L) (hp0 : 0 < p) (hpγ : rr * Dn * p = γ) :
    γ / (8 * rr) ≤ dn * (p * L) / 2

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.sharp_drop_ratio_le
statement:
theorem sharp_drop_ratio_le (γ δ Δ Dn dn L : ℝ)
    (hγ0 : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1 / 2) (hδ2 : 2 ≤ δ) (hδΔ : δ ≤ Δ)
    (hDn3 : 3 ≤ Dn) (hΔDn : Δ < Dn + 1)
    (hδdn : δ ≤ dn) (hdnδ : dn < δ + 1) (hL0 : 0 < L) (hLu : L ≤ 1 - γ + γ ^ 2 / 2) :
    Δ * (dn * L / Dn) ≤ δ * (1 - γ) + γ ^ 2 * Δ + 3

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.sharp_mean_ceiling_arith
statement:
theorem sharp_mean_ceiling_arith {D Dn dn l W C X : ℝ} (hW : 0 ≤ W) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hX : 0 ≤ X)
    (h1 : D ≤ Dn) (h2 : dn ≤ D) :
    D - (D - l) * W + D * C * X ≤ Dn - (dn - l) * W + Dn * C * X

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.sharp_smallness_numeric
statement:
theorem sharp_smallness_numeric (r : ℕ) (hr2 : 2 ≤ r) (γ ε θ α N Dn dn kn Ac p L t : ℝ)
    (hγ0 : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1 / 2) (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1)
    (hN256' : 256 * (r : ℝ) ≤ N * (α ^ 2 * γ)) (hN4 : 4 ≤ N)
    (hDn3 : 3 ≤ Dn) (hdnhalf : Dn / 2 ≤ dn) (hkn0 : 0 ≤ kn)
    (hkn3 : kn ≤ θ * ε ^ 2 * γ * α ^ 2 * Dn / (8192 * (r : ℝ)))
    (hp0 : 0 < p) (hpγ : (r : ℝ) * Dn * p = γ) (hLhalf : 1 / 2 ≤ L)
    (htdef : t = ε * γ * Dn / 16) (hAN : α * N ≤ Ac) :
    (N * ((2 * p * ((r : ℝ) ^ 2 * kn * Dn ^ 2)
          * (1 + p * (r : ℝ) * Dn + (p * (r : ℝ) * Dn) ^ 2)) / t ^ 2)) / (θ * N)
      + (N * (Dn * p) + N ^ 2 * (kn * p + 4 * (r : ℝ) ^ 2 * kn * Dn ^ 2 * p ^ 3))
        / (Ac * (dn * (p * L)) / 2) ^ 2 < 1

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.sharp_survival_bounds
statement:
theorem sharp_survival_bounds {p γ : ℝ} {m : ℕ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (hpγ : (m : ℝ) * p = γ) :
    1 - γ ≤ (1 - p) ^ m ∧ (1 - p) ^ m ≤ 1 - γ + γ ^ 2 / 2

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.sum_biUnion_le_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem sum_biUnion_le_of_nonneg {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (B : Finset β)
    (t : β → Finset α) (g : α → ℝ) (hg : ∀ a, 0 ≤ g a) :
    ∑ u ∈ B.biUnion t, g u ≤ ∑ f ∈ B, ∑ u ∈ t f, g u

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.sum_codegree_biUnion_le
statement:
theorem sum_codegree_biUnion_le (H : Finset (Finset V)) (v : V) (B : Finset (Finset V)) :

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.sum_edgeWeight_eq
statement:
theorem sum_edgeWeight_eq (H : Finset (Finset V)) (v : V) :
    ∑ f ∈ H, edgeWeight H v f
      = ∑ u ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset V).erase v, (codegree H v u : ℝ) * (degree H u : ℝ)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.sum_edgeWeight_le
statement:
theorem sum_edgeWeight_le [Finite V] {H : Finset (Finset V)} {r Δ : ℕ} (hr : IsUniform H r)
    (hΔ : ∀ y : V, degree H y ≤ Δ) (v : V) :
    ∑ f ∈ H, edgeWeight H v f ≤ (r : ℝ) * (Δ : ℝ) ^ 2

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.sum_edgeWeight_sq_le
statement:
theorem sum_edgeWeight_sq_le [Finite V] {H : Finset (Finset V)} {r Δ κ : ℕ} (hr : IsUniform H r)
    (hΔ : ∀ y : V, degree H y ≤ Δ) (hκ : ∀ y z : V, y ≠ z → codegree H y z ≤ κ) (v : V) :
    ∑ f ∈ H, edgeWeight H v f ^ 2 ≤ (r : ℝ) ^ 2 * (κ : ℝ) * (Δ : ℝ) ^ 2

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.sum_meets_swap
statement:
theorem sum_meets_swap (H : Finset (Finset V)) (g : Finset V → ℝ) :
    ∑ k ∈ H, ∑ f ∈ meets H k, g f = ∑ f ∈ H, ((meets H f).card : ℝ) * g f

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.sum_pair_overlap_le_codegree
statement:
theorem sum_pair_overlap_le_codegree {H : Finset (Finset V)} (v : V) {n κ : ℕ}
    (hcard : ∀ e ∈ H.filter (fun e => v ∈ e), (e.erase v).card ≤ n)
    (hκ : ∀ u : V, u ≠ v → codegree H v u ≤ κ) :
    ∑ e ∈ H.filter (fun e => v ∈ e), ∑ e' ∈ H.filter (fun e => v ∈ e),
        (((e ∩ e').erase v).card : ℝ)
      ≤ ((H.filter (fun e => v ∈ e)).card : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) * (κ : ℝ)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.sum_sq_codegree_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_codegree_le [Fintype V] {H : Finset (Finset V)} {r : ℕ} (hr : IsUniform H r)
    {κ : ℝ} (v : V) (hκ : ∀ u : V, u ≠ v → (codegree H v u : ℝ) ≤ κ) :
    ∑ u ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset V).erase v, (codegree H v u : ℝ) ^ 2
      ≤ κ * (((r - 1) * degree H v : ℕ) : ℝ)

name: Hypergraph.biUnion_card

theorem exists_matching_of_oracle_seq_lt [Fintype V]

    {H : Finset (Finset V)} {r : ℕ} (hr : IsUniform H r) (hr1 : 1 ≤ r)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.hasRoundOracle_of_scheduled_invariant
statement:
theorem hasRoundOracle_of_scheduled_invariant (H : Finset (Finset V)) {c β : ℝ}
    (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1) (T : ℕ) (hT : (1 - c) ^ T ≤ β)
    (P : ℕ → Finset (Finset V) → Finset V → Prop)
    (hP0 : P 0 H ∅)
    (hdisj : ∀ (j : ℕ) (H' : Finset (Finset V)) (S : Finset V), P j H' S →
      ∀ e ∈ H', Disjoint e S)
    (hstep : ∀ j, j < T → ∀ (H' : Finset (Finset V)) (S : Finset V), P j H' S →
      β * (Fintype.card V : ℝ) < (Fintype.card V : ℝ) - (S.card : ℝ) →
      ∃ R' : Finset (Finset V), R' ⊆ H' ∧
        P (j + 1) (Hypergraph.residual H' R') (S ∪ support (roundMatching R')) ∧
        c * ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) - (S.card : ℝ))
          ≤ ((support (roundMatching R')).card : ℝ)) :
    HasRoundOracle H c β

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.tight_band_step_hi_core
statement:
theorem tight_band_step_hi_core {a gam n : ℝ} (ha1 : 1 / 2 ≤ a) (ha2 : a ≤ 1)
    (hgam : 0 < gam) (_hgam8 : gam ≤ 1 / 8) (hn : 8 * gam ≤ n) (hn4 : n ≤ 1 / 4) :
    0 ≤ 4 * a * n + 8 * a * n ^ 2 - a * gam * (1 - n) ^ 2 - 8 * a ^ 2 * gam * n * (1 + n)
        - (4 * a * gam) * (1 + n) ^ 2
        - a * (4 * a * gam) * gam * (1 + n) * (1 - n) * (1 - gam)

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.tight_band_step_hi_scaled
statement:
theorem tight_band_step_hi_scaled {a gam eps q qk n : ℝ} (ha1 : 1 / 2 ≤ a) (ha2 : a ≤ 1)
    (hgam : 0 < gam) (hgam8 : gam ≤ 1 / 8) (hn : 8 * gam ≤ n) (hn4 : n ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hqk : 0 < qk) (heps : eps = 4 * a * gam) (hq : q = 1 - a * gam) :
    qk * (1 + n) - a * gam * (qk * (1 - n) - eps * gam * (qk * (1 + n))) * (qk * (1 - n))
          * (1 - gam) / (qk * (1 + n)) + eps * gam * (qk * (1 + n))
      ≤ qk * q * (1 + n * (1 + 8 * a * gam))

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.tight_band_step_lo_core
statement:
theorem tight_band_step_lo_core {a gam n : ℝ} (ha2 : a ≤ 1)
    (hgam : 0 < gam) (_hgam8 : gam ≤ 1 / 8) (hn : 8 * gam ≤ n) (hn4 : n ≤ 1 / 4) :
    0 ≤ 6 * n - 8 * gam - 8 * gam * n - 8 * a * gam * n

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.tight_band_step_lo_scaled
statement:
theorem tight_band_step_lo_scaled {a gam eps q qk n : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha2 : a ≤ 1)
    (hgam : 0 < gam) (hgam8 : gam ≤ 1 / 8) (hn : 8 * gam ≤ n) (hn4 : n ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hqk : 0 < qk) (heps : eps = 4 * a * gam) (hq : q = 1 - a * gam) :
    qk * q * (1 - n * (1 + 8 * a * gam))
      ≤ qk * (1 - n) - a * gam * (qk * (1 + n)) - 2 * eps * gam * (qk * (1 + n))

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.tight_band_width_le_quarter
statement:
theorem tight_band_width_le_quarter {a gam M : ℝ} {T k : ℕ} (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha2 : a ≤ 1)
    (hgam : 0 < gam) (hgam8 : gam ≤ 1 / 8) (hgamE : gam ≤ Real.exp (-(8 * M) - 1) / 32)
    (hM0 : 0 < M) (hgamT_ub : gam * (T : ℝ) ≤ M + gam) (hk : k ≤ T) :
    8 * gam * (1 + 8 * a * gam) ^ k ≤ 1 / 4

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.tight_ceiling_step_bound
statement:
theorem tight_ceiling_step_bound {a gam eps lo hi hi1 d l : ℝ}
    (hd : 0 < d) (hhi0 : 0 < hi) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hgam0 : 0 ≤ gam) (hg1 : 0 ≤ 1 - gam)
    (hlo0 : 0 ≤ lo) (hl : l ≤ eps * gam * (d * hi))
    (hstep : hi - a * gam * (lo - eps * gam * hi) * lo * (1 - gam) / hi + eps * gam * hi ≤ hi1) :
    d * hi - a * gam * (d * lo - l) * (d * lo) * (1 - gam) / (d * hi) + eps * gam * (d * hi)
      ≤ d * hi1

name: LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.Internal.tight_round_step
statement:
theorem tight_round_step {r : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r) {β : ℝ} (Pm : TightParams r β)
    {D₀ c₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 ≤ c₀) (hround : SharpRoundFor r Pm.gam Pm.eps Pm.exc (β / 2) D₀ c₀)
    {W : Type} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    {d κ : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) (hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ)
    (hDlo : D₀ ≤ d * Pm.lomin) (hcodsmall : κ ≤ c₀ * (d * Pm.lomin))
    (hNbig : D₀ ≤ (Fintype.card W : ℝ))
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j < Pm.T)
    {K : Finset (Finset W)} {S E : Finset W}
    (huni : IsUniform K r)
    (hSdisj : ∀ e ∈ K, Disjoint e S)
    (hhi : ∀ v : W, (degree K v : ℝ) ≤ d * Pm.hi j)
    (hlo : ∀ v : W, v ∉ S → v ∉ E → d * Pm.lo j ≤ (degree K v : ℝ))
    (hcodeg : ∀ x y : W, x ≠ y → (codegree K x y : ℝ) ≤ κ)
    (hE : (E.card : ℝ) ≤ Pm.sig j * (Fintype.card W : ℝ))
    (huncov : β * (Fintype.card W : ℝ) < (Fintype.card W : ℝ) - (S.card : ℝ)) :
    ∃ R' : Finset (Finset W), R' ⊆ K ∧
      Pm.gam / (16 * r) * ((Fintype.card W : ℝ) - (S.card : ℝ)) ≤ ((covered R').card : ℝ) ∧
      ∃ (K' : Finset (Finset W)) (E' : Finset W),
        K' ⊆ Hypergraph.residual K R' ∧ IsUniform K' r ∧
        (∀ e ∈ K', Disjoint e (S ∪ covered R')) ∧
        (∀ v : W, (degree K' v : ℝ) ≤ d * Pm.hi (j + 1)) ∧
        (∀ v : W, v ∉ S ∪ covered R' → v ∉ E' → d * Pm.lo (j + 1) ≤ (degree K' v : ℝ)) ∧
        (∀ x y : W, x ≠ y → (codegree K' x y : ℝ) ≤ κ) ∧
        (E'.card : ℝ) ≤ Pm.sig (j + 1) * (Fintype.card W : ℝ)

      (∀ i < k, d₀ ≤ d i) ∧
      (∀ i < k, ∀ e ∈ (colorPart G col i).cliqueFinset 2,
        (edgeTriangleDegree (colorPart G col i) e : ℝ) ≤ (1 + μ) * d i) ∧
      (∀ i < k, ∃ Exc : Finset (Finset V),
        (Exc.card : ℝ) ≤ η * (((colorPart G col i).cliqueFinset 2).card : ℝ) ∧
        ∀ e ∈ (colorPart G col i).cliqueFinset 2, e ∉ Exc →
          (1 - μ) * d i ≤ (edgeTriangleDegree (colorPart G col i) e : ℝ)) ∧
      nu3star G ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k,
        (((colorPart G col i).cliqueFinset 2).card : ℝ) / 3) + ε * (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ^ 2

    (hExc : (Exc.card : ℝ) ≤ η * ((G.cliqueFinset 2).card : ℝ))
    (hhi : ∀ e ∈ G.cliqueFinset 2, (edgeTriangleDegree G e : ℝ) ≤ (1 + μ) * d)
    (hlo : ∀ e ∈ G.cliqueFinset 2, e ∉ Exc → (1 - μ) * d ≤ (edgeTriangleDegree G e : ℝ)) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (col : Finset V → ℕ) (dd : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ i < k, d₀ ≤ dd i) ∧
      (∀ i < k, ∀ e ∈ (colorPart G col i).cliqueFinset 2,
        (edgeTriangleDegree (colorPart G col i) e : ℝ) ≤ (1 + μ) * dd i) ∧
      (∀ i < k, ∃ Exc' : Finset (Finset V),
        (Exc'.card : ℝ) ≤ η * (((colorPart G col i).cliqueFinset 2).card : ℝ) ∧
        ∀ e ∈ (colorPart G col i).cliqueFinset 2, e ∉ Exc' →
          (1 - μ) * dd i ≤ (edgeTriangleDegree (colorPart G col i) e : ℝ)) ∧
      nu3star G ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k,
        (((colorPart G col i).cliqueFinset 2).card : ℝ) / 3) + ε * (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ^ 2

theorem fracNibble_nearlyRegular (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) :
    ∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℝ, 0 < d₀ ∧
      ∀ {W : Type} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] (H : Finset (Finset W)) (w : Finset W → ℝ) (d : ℝ),
        0 < d → d₀ ≤ d → IsUniform H r → NearlyRegularMost H d μ η → CodegreeBounded H (μ * d) →

        (∀ T, 0 ≤ w T) →
        (∀ v : W, ∑ T ∈ H.filter (fun T => v ∈ T), w T ≤ 1) →

name: Nibble.AX1.tripleGraph_near_regular
statement:
theorem tripleGraph_near_regular (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] {U W X : Finset V}
    (hUW : Disjoint U W) (hUX : Disjoint U X) (hWX : Disjoint W X) {ε μ d : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hUWu : G.IsUniform ε U W) (hUXu : G.IsUniform ε U X) (hWXu : G.IsUniform ε W X)
    (hdUW : 2 * ε ≤ (G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ)) (hdUX : 2 * ε ≤ (G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ))
    (hdWX : 2 * ε ≤ (G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ))
    (hXlo : (1 - μ) * d ≤ ((G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ) - ε) * ((G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ) - 2 * ε)
      * (#X : ℝ))
    (hXhi : ((G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ) + ε) * ((G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ) + 2 * ε) * (#X : ℝ)
      ≤ (1 + μ) * d)
    (hWlo : (1 - μ) * d ≤ ((G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ) - ε) * ((G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ) - 2 * ε)
      * (#W : ℝ))
    (hWhi : ((G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ) + ε) * ((G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ) + 2 * ε) * (#W : ℝ)
      ≤ (1 + μ) * d)
    (hUlo : (1 - μ) * d ≤ ((G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ) - ε) * ((G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ) - 2 * ε)
      * (#U : ℝ))
    (hUhi : ((G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ) + ε) * ((G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ) + 2 * ε) * (#U : ℝ)
      ≤ (1 + μ) * d) :
    ∃ Bad : Finset (Finset V),
      ((#Bad : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 4 * ε * ((#U : ℝ) * (#W : ℝ) + (#U : ℝ) * (#X : ℝ)
        + (#W : ℝ) * (#X : ℝ)) ∧
      ∀ e ∈ (tripleGraph G U W X).cliqueFinset 2, e ∉ Bad →
        (1 - μ) * d ≤ (edgeTriangleDegree (tripleGraph G U W X) e : ℝ) ∧
          (edgeTriangleDegree (tripleGraph G U W X) e : ℝ) ≤ (1 + μ) * d

name: Nibble.AX1.tripleGraph_near_regular_pair
statement:
theorem tripleGraph_near_regular_pair (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] {U W X : Finset V}
    (hUW : Disjoint U W) (hUX : Disjoint U X) (hWX : Disjoint W X) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) (hUXu : G.IsUniform ε U X) (hWXu : G.IsUniform ε W X)
    (hdUX : 2 * ε ≤ (G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ)) (hdWX : 2 * ε ≤ (G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ)) :
    ∃ Bad : Finset (Finset V), ((#Bad : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 4 * ε * (#U : ℝ) * (#W : ℝ) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ W, (tripleGraph G U W X).Adj x y → ({x, y} : Finset V) ∉ Bad →
        ((G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ) - ε) * ((G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ) - 2 * ε) * (#X : ℝ)
            ≤ (edgeTriangleDegree (tripleGraph G U W X) {x, y} : ℝ) ∧
          (edgeTriangleDegree (tripleGraph G U W X) {x, y} : ℝ)
            ≤ ((G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ) + ε) * ((G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ) + 2 * ε) * (#X : ℝ)

name: Nibble.AX1.uniform_triple_codegree
statement:
theorem uniform_triple_codegree (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] {A B C : Finset V} {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) (hAC : G.IsUniform ε A C) (hBC : G.IsUniform ε B C)
    (hdAC : 2 * ε ≤ (G.edgeDensity A C : ℝ)) (hdBC : 2 * ε ≤ (G.edgeDensity B C : ℝ)) :
    ((#{p ∈ A ×ˢ B | ¬ (((G.edgeDensity A C : ℝ) - ε) * ((G.edgeDensity B C : ℝ) - 2 * ε)
            * (#C : ℝ) ≤ (codegreeIn G C p.1 p.2 : ℝ) ∧
          (codegreeIn G C p.1 p.2 : ℝ) ≤ ((G.edgeDensity A C : ℝ) + ε)
            * ((G.edgeDensity B C : ℝ) + 2 * ε) * (#C : ℝ))} : ℕ) : ℝ)
      ≤ 4 * ε * (#A : ℝ) * (#B : ℝ)

name: Nibble.AX1.uniform_triple_member
statement:
theorem uniform_triple_member (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] {U W X : Finset V}
    (hUW : Disjoint U W) (hUX : Disjoint U X) (hWX : Disjoint W X) {ε μ d t : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hUWu : G.IsUniform ε U W) (hUXu : G.IsUniform ε U X) (hWXu : G.IsUniform ε W X)
    (hdUW : 2 * ε ≤ (G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ)) (hdUX : 2 * ε ≤ (G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ))
    (hdWX : 2 * ε ≤ (G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ))
    (hXlo : (1 - μ) * d ≤ ((G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ) - ε) * ((G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ) - 2 * ε)
      * (#X : ℝ))
    (hXhi : ((G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ) + ε) * ((G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ) + 2 * ε) * (#X : ℝ)
      ≤ (1 + μ) * d)
    (hWlo : (1 - μ) * d ≤ ((G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ) - ε) * ((G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ) - 2 * ε)
      * (#W : ℝ))
    (hWhi : ((G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ) + ε) * ((G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ) + 2 * ε) * (#W : ℝ)
      ≤ (1 + μ) * d)
    (hUlo : (1 - μ) * d ≤ ((G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ) - ε) * ((G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ) - 2 * ε)
      * (#U : ℝ))
    (hUhi : ((G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ) + ε) * ((G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ) + 2 * ε) * (#U : ℝ)
      ≤ (1 + μ) * d) :
    ∃ Bad : Finset (Finset V),
      ((#Bad : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 4 * ε * ((#U : ℝ) * (#W : ℝ) + (#U : ℝ) * (#X : ℝ)
        + (#W : ℝ) * (#X : ℝ)) ∧
      prune (tripleGraph G U W X) Bad ≤ G ∧
      (∀ e ∈ (prune (tripleGraph G U W X) Bad).cliqueFinset 2,
        (edgeTriangleDegree (prune (tripleGraph G U W X) Bad) e : ℝ) ≤ (1 + μ) * d) ∧
      (∃ Exc : Finset (Finset V),
        ((#Exc : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (2 * ((#Bad : ℕ) : ℝ) / t) * (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ∧
        ∀ e ∈ (prune (tripleGraph G U W X) Bad).cliqueFinset 2, e ∉ Exc →
          (1 - μ) * d - 2 * t
            ≤ (edgeTriangleDegree (prune (tripleGraph G U W X) Bad) e : ℝ)) ∧
      ((#((tripleGraph G U W X).cliqueFinset 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - ((#Bad : ℕ) : ℝ)
        ≤ ((#((prune (tripleGraph G U W X) Bad).cliqueFinset 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)

name: Nibble.AX1.hasNearRegularFamily_of_subTripleDesign
statement:
theorem hasNearRegularFamily_of_subTripleDesign
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] {ε μ η d₀ ε₂ μ₂ t : ℝ}
    (k : ℕ) (A B C : ℕ → Finset V) (d Elo : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hε₂ : 0 < ε₂) (hε₂1 : ε₂ ≤ 1) (ht : 0 < t) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hdAB : ∀ i < k, Disjoint (A i) (B i))
    (hdAC : ∀ i < k, Disjoint (A i) (C i))
    (hdBC : ∀ i < k, Disjoint (B i) (C i))
    (huAB : ∀ i < k, G.IsUniform ε₂ (A i) (B i))
    (huAC : ∀ i < k, G.IsUniform ε₂ (A i) (C i))
    (huBC : ∀ i < k, G.IsUniform ε₂ (B i) (C i))
    (hρAB : ∀ i < k, 2 * ε₂ ≤ (G.edgeDensity (A i) (B i) : ℝ))
    (hρAC : ∀ i < k, 2 * ε₂ ≤ (G.edgeDensity (A i) (C i) : ℝ))
    (hρBC : ∀ i < k, 2 * ε₂ ≤ (G.edgeDensity (B i) (C i) : ℝ))
    (hClo : ∀ i < k, (1 - μ₂) * d i ≤ ((G.edgeDensity (A i) (C i) : ℝ) - ε₂)
      * ((G.edgeDensity (B i) (C i) : ℝ) - 2 * ε₂) * (#(C i) : ℝ))
    (hChi : ∀ i < k, ((G.edgeDensity (A i) (C i) : ℝ) + ε₂)
      * ((G.edgeDensity (B i) (C i) : ℝ) + 2 * ε₂) * (#(C i) : ℝ) ≤ (1 + μ₂) * d i)
    (hBlo : ∀ i < k, (1 - μ₂) * d i ≤ ((G.edgeDensity (A i) (B i) : ℝ) - ε₂)
      * ((G.edgeDensity (B i) (C i) : ℝ) - 2 * ε₂) * (#(B i) : ℝ))
    (hBhi : ∀ i < k, ((G.edgeDensity (A i) (B i) : ℝ) + ε₂)
      * ((G.edgeDensity (B i) (C i) : ℝ) + 2 * ε₂) * (#(B i) : ℝ) ≤ (1 + μ₂) * d i)
    (hAlo : ∀ i < k, (1 - μ₂) * d i ≤ ((G.edgeDensity (A i) (B i) : ℝ) - ε₂)
      * ((G.edgeDensity (A i) (C i) : ℝ) - 2 * ε₂) * (#(A i) : ℝ))
    (hAhi : ∀ i < k, ((G.edgeDensity (A i) (B i) : ℝ) + ε₂)
      * ((G.edgeDensity (A i) (C i) : ℝ) + 2 * ε₂) * (#(A i) : ℝ) ≤ (1 + μ₂) * d i)
    (hd₀ : ∀ i < k, d₀ ≤ d i) (hdnn : ∀ i < k, 0 ≤ d i) (hμ₂ : μ₂ ≤ μ)
    (hslack : ∀ i < k, 2 * t ≤ (μ - μ₂) * d i)
    (hpair : ∀ i < k, ∀ j < k, i ≠ j → ∀ x y,
      (tripleGraph G (A i) (B i) (C i)).Adj x y → ¬ (tripleGraph G (A j) (B j) (C j)).Adj x y)
    (hElo : ∀ i < k, Elo i ≤ (#((tripleGraph G (A i) (B i) (C i)).cliqueFinset 2) : ℝ))
    (hexc : ∀ i < k, (2 * designBad ε₂ (A i) (B i) (C i) / t) * (Fintype.card V : ℝ)
      ≤ η * (Elo i - designBad ε₂ (A i) (B i) (C i)))
    (hcover : nu3star G ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k,
      (Elo i - designBad ε₂ (A i) (B i) (C i)) / 3) + ε * (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ^ 2) :
    HasNearRegularFamily G ε μ η d₀

    (hε₂ : 0 < ε₂) (hε₂1 : ε₂ ≤ 1) (ht : 0 < t) (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hμ₂ : μ₂ ≤ μ)

    (hcover : nu3star G ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k,

name: Nibble.AX1.scale_window
statement:
theorem scale_window {x y z x' y' s τ d δ μ ε e : ℝ}
    (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hx : δ ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) (hy : δ ≤ y) (hy1 : y ≤ 1) (hz : δ ≤ z) (hz1 : z ≤ 1)
    (hx' : |x' - x| ≤ e) (hy' : |y' - y| ≤ e)
    (hs : |s - τ * z| ≤ 1)
    (he : 0 ≤ e) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hμ0 : 0 < μ) (hμ1 : μ ≤ 1)
    (hE : e + 2 * ε ≤ μ * δ ^ 3 / 12)
    (hτ : 2 / (μ * δ ^ 3) ≤ τ)
    (hd : d = τ * (x * y * z)) :
    (1 - μ) * d ≤ (x' - ε) * (y' - 2 * ε) * s ∧ (x' + ε) * (y' + 2 * ε) * s ≤ (1 + μ) * d

name: Nibble.AX1.subTripleShape_grid
statement:
theorem subTripleShape_grid (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] {U W X : Finset V}
    {δ μ₂ ε₁ α τ : ℝ} {sA sB sC nA nB nC : ℕ}
    (hUW : Disjoint U W) (hUX : Disjoint U X) (hWX : Disjoint W X)
    (huUW : G.IsUniform ε₁ U W) (huUX : G.IsUniform ε₁ U X) (huWX : G.IsUniform ε₁ W X)
    (hε₁ : 0 < ε₁) (hαε : ε₁ ≤ α) (hα2 : 2 * α ≤ 1)
    (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hμ0 : 0 < μ₂) (hμ1 : μ₂ ≤ 1)
    (hx : δ ≤ (G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ)) (hy : δ ≤ (G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ))
    (hz : δ ≤ (G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ))
    (hErr : ε₁ + 2 * (ε₁ / α) ≤ μ₂ * δ ^ 3 / 12)
    (hdense : 2 * (ε₁ / α) + ε₁ ≤ δ)
    (hτ : 2 / (μ₂ * δ ^ 3) ≤ τ)
    (hsA : |(sA : ℝ) - τ * (G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ)| ≤ 1)
    (hsB : |(sB : ℝ) - τ * (G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ)| ≤ 1)
    (hsC : |(sC : ℝ) - τ * (G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ)| ≤ 1)
    (hsA0 : 0 < sA) (hsB0 : 0 < sB) (hsC0 : 0 < sC)
    (hfitA : nA * sA ≤ #U) (hfitB : nB * sB ≤ #W) (hfitC : nC * sC ≤ #X)
    (hrelA : α * (#U : ℝ) ≤ (sA : ℝ)) (hrelB : α * (#W : ℝ) ≤ (sB : ℝ))
    (hrelC : α * (#X : ℝ) ≤ (sC : ℝ))
    (hBA : nB ≤ nA) (hCA : nC ≤ nA) :
    IsSubTripleShape G (ε₁ / α) μ₂ (nB * nC)
      (fun i => blockOf U sA (rectIdxA nA nC i))
      (fun i => blockOf W sB (rectIdxB nC i))
      (fun i => blockOf X sC (rectIdxC nC i))
      (fun _ => τ * ((G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ) * (G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ)
        * (G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ)))

name: Nibble.AX1.tripleFamily_pairwise_edgeDisjoint
statement:
theorem tripleFamily_pairwise_edgeDisjoint (G : SimpleGraph V) {nA nB nC k : ℕ}
    (Ub Wb Xb : ℕ → Finset V) (IA IB IC : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hIA : ∀ i < k, IA i < nA) (hIB : ∀ i < k, IB i < nB) (hIC : ∀ i < k, IC i < nC)
    (hUU : ∀ a < nA, ∀ b < nA, a ≠ b → Disjoint (Ub a) (Ub b))
    (hWW : ∀ a < nB, ∀ b < nB, a ≠ b → Disjoint (Wb a) (Wb b))
    (hXX : ∀ a < nC, ∀ b < nC, a ≠ b → Disjoint (Xb a) (Xb b))
    (hUW : ∀ a < nA, ∀ b < nB, Disjoint (Ub a) (Wb b))
    (hUX : ∀ a < nA, ∀ b < nC, Disjoint (Ub a) (Xb b))
    (hWX : ∀ a < nB, ∀ b < nC, Disjoint (Wb a) (Xb b))
    (hABinj : ∀ i < k, ∀ i' < k, IA i = IA i' → IB i = IB i' → i = i')
    (hACinj : ∀ i < k, ∀ i' < k, IA i = IA i' → IC i = IC i' → i = i')
    (hBCinj : ∀ i < k, ∀ i' < k, IB i = IB i' → IC i = IC i' → i = i')
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i < k) {i' : ℕ} (hi' : i' < k) (hne : i ≠ i') (x y : V)
    (h : (tripleGraph G (Ub (IA i)) (Wb (IB i)) (Xb (IC i))).Adj x y) :
    ¬ (tripleGraph G (Ub (IA i')) (Wb (IB i')) (Xb (IC i'))).Adj x y

name: Nibble.AX1.edgeDensity_regularityReduced
statement:
theorem edgeDensity_regularityReduced (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (P : Finpartition (univ : Finset V)) {ep de : ℝ} {U W A B : Finset V}
    (hU : U ∈ P.parts) (hW : W ∈ P.parts) (hUW : U ≠ W)
    (hu : G.IsUniform ep U W) (hd : de ≤ (G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ))
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hB : B ⊆ W) :
    (G.regularityReduced P ep de).edgeDensity A B = G.edgeDensity A B

name: Nibble.AX1.gridSubTriple_data
statement:
theorem gridSubTriple_data (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (P : Finpartition (univ : Finset V)) {δ α τ ε₁ : ℝ} {U W X A B C : Finset V}
    (hε₁ : 0 < ε₁) (hαε : ε₁ / 8 ≤ α) (hα2 : 2 * α ≤ 1) (hde : ε₁ / 4 ≤ δ)
    (h : IsGridSubTriple G P (ε₁ / 8) δ α τ U W X A B C) :
    (Disjoint A B ∧ Disjoint A C ∧ Disjoint B C) ∧
    ((G.regularityReduced P (ε₁ / 8) (ε₁ / 4)).IsUniform (ε₁ / 8 / α) A B ∧
      (G.regularityReduced P (ε₁ / 8) (ε₁ / 4)).IsUniform (ε₁ / 8 / α) A C ∧
      (G.regularityReduced P (ε₁ / 8) (ε₁ / 4)).IsUniform (ε₁ / 8 / α) B C) ∧
    (|((G.regularityReduced P (ε₁ / 8) (ε₁ / 4)).edgeDensity A B : ℝ)
        - (G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ)| ≤ ε₁ / 8 ∧
      |((G.regularityReduced P (ε₁ / 8) (ε₁ / 4)).edgeDensity A C : ℝ)
        - (G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ)| ≤ ε₁ / 8 ∧
      |((G.regularityReduced P (ε₁ / 8) (ε₁ / 4)).edgeDensity B C : ℝ)
        - (G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ)| ≤ ε₁ / 8)

statement:
theorem subTripleShape_of_gridSubTriples (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (P : Finpartition (univ : Finset V)) {δ α τ μ₂ ε₁ : ℝ} {k : ℕ}
    (U W X A B C : ℕ → Finset V)
    (hε₁ : 0 < ε₁) (hαε : ε₁ / 8 ≤ α) (hα2 : 2 * α ≤ 1)
    (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hμ0 : 0 < μ₂) (hμ1 : μ₂ ≤ 1)
    (hde : ε₁ / 4 ≤ δ)
    (hErr : ε₁ / 8 + 2 * (ε₁ / 8 / α) ≤ μ₂ * δ ^ 3 / 12)
    (hdense : 2 * (ε₁ / 8 / α) + ε₁ / 8 ≤ δ)
    (hτ : 2 / (μ₂ * δ ^ 3) ≤ τ)
    (hgrid : ∀ i < k, IsGridSubTriple G P (ε₁ / 8) δ α τ (U i) (W i) (X i) (A i) (B i) (C i))
    (hdisj : ∀ i < k, ∀ j < k, i ≠ j →
      Disjoint (tripleRect (A i) (B i) (C i)) (tripleRect (A j) (B j) (C j))) :
    IsSubTripleShape (G.regularityReduced P (ε₁ / 8) (ε₁ / 4)) (ε₁ / 8 / α) μ₂ k A B C
      (fun i => τ * ((G.edgeDensity (U i) (W i) : ℝ) * (G.edgeDensity (U i) (X i) : ℝ)
        * (G.edgeDensity (W i) (X i) : ℝ)))

statement:
theorem prune_near_regular_local (T : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel T.Adj]
    (Bad : Finset (Finset V)) {μ d t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) {D : ℕ}
    (hdeg : ∀ v : V, #{z ∈ (univ : Finset V) | T.Adj v z} ≤ D)
    (hhi : ∀ e ∈ T.cliqueFinset 2, e ∉ Bad → (edgeTriangleDegree T e : ℝ) ≤ (1 + μ) * d)
    (hlo : ∀ e ∈ T.cliqueFinset 2, e ∉ Bad → (1 - μ) * d ≤ (edgeTriangleDegree T e : ℝ)) :
    (∀ e ∈ (prune T Bad).cliqueFinset 2,
        (edgeTriangleDegree (prune T Bad) e : ℝ) ≤ (1 + μ) * d) ∧
      ∃ Exc : Finset (Finset V), ((#Exc : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (2 * (#Bad : ℝ) / t) * (D : ℝ) ∧
        ∀ e ∈ (prune T Bad).cliqueFinset 2, e ∉ Exc →
          (1 - μ) * d - 2 * t ≤ (edgeTriangleDegree (prune T Bad) e : ℝ)

name: Nibble.AX1.uniform_triple_member_local
statement:
theorem uniform_triple_member_local (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] {U W X : Finset V}
    (hUW : Disjoint U W) (hUX : Disjoint U X) (hWX : Disjoint W X) {ε μ d t : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hUWu : G.IsUniform ε U W) (hUXu : G.IsUniform ε U X) (hWXu : G.IsUniform ε W X)
    (hdUW : 2 * ε ≤ (G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ)) (hdUX : 2 * ε ≤ (G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ))
    (hdWX : 2 * ε ≤ (G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ))
    (hXlo : (1 - μ) * d ≤ ((G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ) - ε) * ((G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ) - 2 * ε)
      * (#X : ℝ))
    (hXhi : ((G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ) + ε) * ((G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ) + 2 * ε) * (#X : ℝ)
      ≤ (1 + μ) * d)
    (hWlo : (1 - μ) * d ≤ ((G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ) - ε) * ((G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ) - 2 * ε)
      * (#W : ℝ))
    (hWhi : ((G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ) + ε) * ((G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ) + 2 * ε) * (#W : ℝ)
      ≤ (1 + μ) * d)
    (hUlo : (1 - μ) * d ≤ ((G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ) - ε) * ((G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ) - 2 * ε)
      * (#U : ℝ))
    (hUhi : ((G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ) + ε) * ((G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ) + 2 * ε) * (#U : ℝ)
      ≤ (1 + μ) * d) :
    ∃ Bad : Finset (Finset V),
      ((#Bad : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 4 * ε * ((#U : ℝ) * (#W : ℝ) + (#U : ℝ) * (#X : ℝ)
        + (#W : ℝ) * (#X : ℝ)) ∧
      prune (tripleGraph G U W X) Bad ≤ G ∧
      (∀ e ∈ (prune (tripleGraph G U W X) Bad).cliqueFinset 2,
        (edgeTriangleDegree (prune (tripleGraph G U W X) Bad) e : ℝ) ≤ (1 + μ) * d) ∧
      (∃ Exc : Finset (Finset V),
        ((#Exc : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (2 * ((#Bad : ℕ) : ℝ) / t) * ((#U : ℝ) + (#W : ℝ) + (#X : ℝ)) ∧
        ∀ e ∈ (prune (tripleGraph G U W X) Bad).cliqueFinset 2, e ∉ Exc →
          (1 - μ) * d - 2 * t
            ≤ (edgeTriangleDegree (prune (tripleGraph G U W X) Bad) e : ℝ)) ∧
      ((#((tripleGraph G U W X).cliqueFinset 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - ((#Bad : ℕ) : ℝ)
        ≤ ((#((prune (tripleGraph G U W X) Bad).cliqueFinset 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)

name: Nibble.AX1.cover_sum_le_cluster_capacity
statement:
theorem cover_sum_le_cluster_capacity
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (P : Finpartition (univ : Finset V))
    (k : ℕ) (U W X A B C : ℕ → Finset V)
    (hU : ∀ i < k, U i ∈ P.parts) (hW : ∀ i < k, W i ∈ P.parts) (hX : ∀ i < k, X i ∈ P.parts)
    (hUW : ∀ i < k, U i ≠ W i) (hUX : ∀ i < k, U i ≠ X i) (hWX : ∀ i < k, W i ≠ X i)
    (hA : ∀ i < k, A i ⊆ U i) (hB : ∀ i < k, B i ⊆ W i) (hC : ∀ i < k, C i ⊆ X i)
    (hdisj : ∀ i < k, ∀ j < k, i ≠ j →
      Disjoint (tripleRect (A i) (B i) (C i)) (tripleRect (A j) (B j) (C j))) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, ((G.edgeDensity (U i) (W i) : ℝ) * (#(A i) : ℝ) * (#(B i) : ℝ)
        + (G.edgeDensity (U i) (X i) : ℝ) * (#(A i) : ℝ) * (#(C i) : ℝ)
        + (G.edgeDensity (W i) (X i) : ℝ) * (#(B i) : ℝ) * (#(C i) : ℝ)) / 3
      ≤ (∑ p ∈ P.parts.offDiag, (G.edgeDensity p.1 p.2 : ℝ) * (#p.1 : ℝ) * (#p.2 : ℝ)) / 6

statement:
theorem six_le_card_partPairs_of_mem_triangleHypergraph (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (P : Finpartition (univ : Finset V)) {ep de : ℝ} {T : Finset (Finset V)}
    (hT : T ∈ triangleHypergraphE (G.regularityReduced P ep de)) :
    6 ≤ #(P.parts.offDiag.filter
      (fun p => ∃ x ∈ p.1, ∃ y ∈ p.2, ({x, y} : Finset V) ∈ T))

name: Nibble.AX1.sum_area_offDiag_le
statement:
theorem sum_area_offDiag_le (P : Finpartition (univ : Finset V)) :
    ∑ p ∈ P.parts.offDiag, (#p.1 : ℝ) * (#p.2 : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ^ 2

name: Nibble.AX1.sum_card_inter_le
statement:
theorem sum_card_inter_le (R : ℕ → Finset (V × V)) (F : Finset ℕ) (S : Finset (V × V))
    (hdisj : ∀ i ∈ F, ∀ j ∈ F, i ≠ j → Disjoint (R i) (R j)) :
    ∑ i ∈ F, (#(R i ∩ S) : ℝ) ≤ (#S : ℝ)

name: Nibble.AX1.two_cover_le_sum_pairArea
statement:
theorem two_cover_le_sum_pairArea (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (P : Finpartition (univ : Finset V)) {U W X A B C : Finset V}
    (hU : U ∈ P.parts) (hW : W ∈ P.parts) (hX : X ∈ P.parts)
    (hUW : U ≠ W) (hUX : U ≠ X) (hWX : W ≠ X)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hB : B ⊆ W) (hC : C ⊆ X) :
    2 * ((G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ) * (#A : ℝ) * (#B : ℝ)
        + (G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ) * (#A : ℝ) * (#C : ℝ)
        + (G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ) * (#B : ℝ) * (#C : ℝ))
      ≤ ∑ p ∈ P.parts.offDiag, pairArea G (tripleRect A B C) p

    ∃ i j : Fin q, t'.filter (fun v => v.1 = a ∨ v.1 = b) = {(a, i), (b, j)} ∧
      ({(a, i), (b, j)} : Finset (W × Fin q)) ⊆ t'

name: Nibble.AX1.card_blowUp_fiber

statement:
theorem card_blowUp_fiber_edge (H : SimpleGraph W) [DecidableRel H.Adj] (q : ℕ) {t : Finset W}

theorem exists_edge_of_mem_hostTri (P : Finpartition (univ : Finset V)) {t : Finset V}

name: Nibble.AX1.hostGraph_adj
statement:
theorem hostGraph_adj {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {P : Finpartition (univ : Finset V)} {ep de : ℝ} {S T : {S : Finset V // S ∈ P.parts}} :
    (hostGraph G P ep de).Adj S T ↔ (S : Finset V) ≠ (T : Finset V) ∧
      G.IsUniform ep (S : Finset V) (T : Finset V) ∧

name: Nibble.AX1.isFracPacking_liftWeight

name: Nibble.AX1.mem_partClass_iff

theorem mem_partClass_iff (P : Finpartition (univ : Finset V)) (t : Finset V) (U : Finset V) :

name: Nibble.AX1.nu3star_blowUp
statement:
theorem nu3star_blowUp (H : SimpleGraph W) [DecidableRel H.Adj] {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :

name: Nibble.AX1.nu3star_blowUp_ge
statement:
theorem nu3star_blowUp_ge (H : SimpleGraph W) [DecidableRel H.Adj] {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :

name: Nibble.AX1.nu3star_blowUp_le
statement:
theorem nu3star_blowUp_le (H : SimpleGraph W) [DecidableRel H.Adj] {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :

statement:
theorem nu3star_regularityReduced_le_host (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]

name: Nibble.AX1.sum_liftWeight
statement:
theorem sum_liftWeight (H : SimpleGraph W) [DecidableRel H.Adj] {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (w : Finset (Finset W) → ℝ) :
    ∑ T' ∈ triangleHypergraphE (blowUp H q), liftWeight H q w T'
      = (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ T ∈ triangleHypergraphE H, w T

name: Nibble.AX1.sum_pair_classes_le
statement:
theorem sum_pair_classes_le (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (P : Finpartition (univ : Finset V)) {w : Finset (Finset V) → ℝ} (hw : IsFracPacking G w)
    (hdist : ∀ t ∈ G.cliqueFinset 3, #(partClass P t) = 3) {U W : Finset V} (hUW : U ≠ W) :
    ∑ S ∈ (P.parts.powersetCard 3).filter (fun S => U ∈ S ∧ W ∈ S),
        ∑ t ∈ (G.cliqueFinset 3).filter (fun t => partClass P t = S), w (t.powersetCard 2)
      ≤ (#(G.interedges U W) : ℝ)

name: Nibble.AX1.sum_projWeight
statement:
theorem sum_projWeight (H : SimpleGraph W) [DecidableRel H.Adj] {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (w' : Finset (Finset (W × Fin q)) → ℝ) :
    (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ T ∈ triangleHypergraphE H, projWeight H q w' T
      = ∑ T' ∈ triangleHypergraphE (blowUp H q), w' T'

name: Nibble.AX1.sum_split_partClass
statement:
theorem sum_split_partClass (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (P : Finpartition (univ : Finset V)) (f : Finset V → ℝ)
    (hdist : ∀ t ∈ G.cliqueFinset 3, #(partClass P t) = 3) :
    ∑ S ∈ P.parts.powersetCard 3,
        ∑ t ∈ (G.cliqueFinset 3).filter (fun t => partClass P t = S), f t
      = ∑ t ∈ G.cliqueFinset 3, f t

name: Nibble.AX1.sum_triangleHypergraphE
statement:
theorem sum_triangleHypergraphE {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (f : Finset (Finset V) → ℝ) :
    ∑ T ∈ triangleHypergraphE G, f T = ∑ t ∈ G.cliqueFinset 3, f (t.powersetCard 2)

name: Nibble.AX1.sum_triangleHypergraphE_filter
statement:
theorem sum_triangleHypergraphE_filter {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] {e : Finset V} (he : #e = 2) (f : Finset (Finset V) → ℝ) :
    ∑ T ∈ (triangleHypergraphE G).filter (fun T => e ∈ T), f T
      = ∑ t ∈ (G.cliqueFinset 3).filter (fun t => e ⊆ t), f (t.powersetCard 2)

name: Nibble.AX1.vtxSet_powersetCard_two

theorem vtxSet_powersetCard_two {X : Type} [DecidableEq X] {t : Finset X} (ht : 2 ≤ #t) :

name: Nibble.YusterE.fracPacking_to_triangleFracPacking
statement:
theorem fracPacking_to_triangleFracPacking
    {w' : Finset (Finset V) → ℝ} (hw' : IsFracPacking G w') :
    IsTriangleFracPacking G (fun t => w' (t.powersetCard 2)) ∧
      (∑ t ∈ G.cliqueFinset 3, w' (t.powersetCard 2)) =
        ∑ T ∈ triangleHypergraphE G, w' T

name: Nibble.YusterE.mem_powersetCard_two_iff_subset
statement:
theorem mem_powersetCard_two_iff_subset {e t : Finset V} (he : e.card = 2) :
    e ∈ t.powersetCard 2 ↔ e ⊆ t

name: Nibble.YusterE.nu3star_eq_triangleFrac_sSup
statement:
theorem nu3star_eq_triangleFrac_sSup :
    nu3star G =
      sSup {x : ℝ | ∃ w : Finset V → ℝ, IsTriangleFracPacking G w ∧
        x = ∑ t ∈ G.cliqueFinset 3, w t}

name: Nibble.YusterE.sum_clique_powersetCard_two
statement:
theorem sum_clique_powersetCard_two (w : Finset (Finset V) → ℝ) :
    ∑ t ∈ G.cliqueFinset 3, w (t.powersetCard 2) =
      ∑ T ∈ triangleHypergraphE G, w T

name: Nibble.YusterE.sum_triangleHypergraphE_sup
statement:
theorem sum_triangleHypergraphE_sup (w : Finset V → ℝ) :
    ∑ T ∈ triangleHypergraphE G, w (T.sup id) =
      ∑ t ∈ G.cliqueFinset 3, w t

name: Nibble.YusterE.triangleFracPacking_to_fracPacking
statement:
theorem triangleFracPacking_to_fracPacking
    {w : Finset V → ℝ} (hw : IsTriangleFracPacking G w) :
    let w' : Finset (Finset V) → ℝ :=
      fun T => if T ∈ triangleHypergraphE G then w (T.sup id) else 0
    IsFracPacking G w' ∧
      (∑ T ∈ triangleHypergraphE G, w' T) =
        ∑ t ∈ G.cliqueFinset 3, w t

name: Nibble.YusterE.triangleHypergraphE_filter_eq_image
statement:
theorem triangleHypergraphE_filter_eq_image (e : Finset V) (he : e.card = 2) :
    (triangleHypergraphE G).filter (fun T => e ∈ T) =
      ((G.cliqueFinset 3).filter (fun t => e ⊆ t)).image
        (fun t => t.powersetCard 2)

name: Nibble.YusterE.triangle_powersetCard_two_injOn
statement:
theorem triangle_powersetCard_two_injOn :

theorem triangle_powersetCard_two_sup {t : Finset V} (ht : G.IsNClique 3 t) :

theorem clusterLPValue_le_sq (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (P : Finpartition (univ : Finset V)) (ep de : ℝ)
    {y : Finset {S : Finset V // S ∈ P.parts} → ℝ} (hy : IsClusterTripleLP G P ep de y) :

name: Nibble.AX1.cover_approx_of_gridSubTriple
statement:
theorem cover_approx_of_gridSubTriple (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (P : Finpartition (univ : Finset V)) {ep de α τ : ℝ} {U W X A B C : Finset V}
    (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (h : IsGridSubTriple G P ep de α τ U W X A B C) :
    |((G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ) * (#A : ℝ) * (#B : ℝ)
        + (G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ) * (#A : ℝ) * (#C : ℝ)
        + (G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ) * (#B : ℝ) * (#C : ℝ))
      - 3 * τ ^ 2 * ((G.edgeDensity U W : ℝ) * (G.edgeDensity U X : ℝ)
          * (G.edgeDensity W X : ℝ))| ≤ 6 * τ + 3

statement:
theorem exists_clusterTripleLP (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
