    ∃ x : Finset {S : Finset V // S ∈ P.parts} → ℝ, IsClusterTripleLP G P ep de x ∧
      nu3star (G.regularityReduced P ep de) ≤ clusterLPValue x + η

name: Nibble.AX1.exists_clusters_of_mem_tripleRect
statement:
theorem exists_clusters_of_mem_tripleRect {U W X A B C : Finset V}
    (hUW : U ≠ W) (hUX : U ≠ X) (hWX : W ≠ X)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hB : B ⊆ W) (hC : C ⊆ X) {u v : V} (h : (u, v) ∈ tripleRect A B C) :
    ∃ S ∈ ({U, W, X} : Finset (Finset V)), ∃ T ∈ ({U, W, X} : Finset (Finset V)),
      S ≠ T ∧ u ∈ S ∧ v ∈ T

name: Nibble.AX1.exists_gridSubTriple_family_of_placement
statement:
theorem exists_gridSubTriple_family_of_placement
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (Pp : Finpartition (univ : Finset V))
    {ep de α τ : ℝ} {l Pn : ℕ} (hl : 0 < l)
    {κ : Type}
    (cl : κ → ZMod 3 → {S : Finset V // S ∈ Pp.parts})
    (sz bs : κ → ZMod 3 → ℕ) (I : κ → ZMod 3 → Finset (Fin Pn)) (Good : Finset κ)
    (hcard : ∀ c a, #(I c a) = sz c a)
    (hfitS : ∀ S ∈ Pp.parts, Pn * l ≤ #S)
    (hbs : ∀ c a, bs c a ≤ sz c a * l)
    (hdisjI : ∀ c ∈ Good, ∀ c' ∈ Good, c ≠ c' → ∀ a b a' b' : ZMod 3, a ≠ b → a' ≠ b' →
      cl c a = cl c' a' → cl c b = cl c' b' →
      Disjoint (I c a) (I c' a') ∨ Disjoint (I c b) (I c' b'))
    (hgood : ∀ c ∈ Good,
      GoodTriple G Pp ep de (cl c 0 : Finset V) (cl c 1 : Finset V) (cl c 2 : Finset V))
    (hrel : ∀ c ∈ Good, ∀ a : ZMod 3, α * (#(cl c a : Finset V) : ℝ) ≤ (bs c a : ℝ))
    (hshape : ∀ c ∈ Good, ∀ a : ZMod 3,
      |(bs c a : ℝ)
        - τ * (G.edgeDensity (cl c (a + 1) : Finset V) (cl c (a + 2) : Finset V) : ℝ)| ≤ 1) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (U W X A B C : ℕ → Finset V),
      k ≤ #Good ∧
      (∀ i < k, IsGridSubTriple G Pp ep de α τ (U i) (W i) (X i) (A i) (B i) (C i)) ∧
      (∀ i < k, ∀ j < k, i ≠ j →
        Disjoint (tripleRect (A i) (B i) (C i)) (tripleRect (A j) (B j) (C j))) ∧
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, τ ^ 2 * ((G.edgeDensity (U i) (W i) : ℝ)
          * (G.edgeDensity (U i) (X i) : ℝ) * (G.edgeDensity (W i) (X i) : ℝ)))
        = ∑ c ∈ Good, τ ^ 2 * ((G.edgeDensity (cl c 0 : Finset V) (cl c 1 : Finset V) : ℝ)
            * (G.edgeDensity (cl c 0 : Finset V) (cl c 2 : Finset V) : ℝ)
            * (G.edgeDensity (cl c 1 : Finset V) (cl c 2 : Finset V) : ℝ))

name: Nibble.AX1.nu3star_le_cover_of_family_lp_value
statement:
theorem nu3star_le_cover_of_family_lp_value
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (P : Finpartition (univ : Finset V))
    {ep de ep₀ de₀ α τ E η : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (U W X A B C : ℕ → Finset V) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ)
    (hgrid : ∀ i < k, IsGridSubTriple G P ep₀ de₀ α τ (U i) (W i) (X i) (A i) (B i) (C i))
    {x : Finset {S : Finset V // S ∈ P.parts} → ℝ}
    (hnu : nu3star (G.regularityReduced P ep de) ≤ clusterLPValue x + η)
    (hval : clusterLPValue x
        ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, τ ^ 2 * ((G.edgeDensity (U i) (W i) : ℝ)
            * (G.edgeDensity (U i) (X i) : ℝ) * (G.edgeDensity (W i) (X i) : ℝ))) + E) :
    nu3star (G.regularityReduced P ep de)
      ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k,
          ((G.edgeDensity (U i) (W i) : ℝ) * (#(A i) : ℝ) * (#(B i) : ℝ)
            + (G.edgeDensity (U i) (X i) : ℝ) * (#(A i) : ℝ) * (#(C i) : ℝ)
            + (G.edgeDensity (W i) (X i) : ℝ) * (#(B i) : ℝ) * (#(C i) : ℝ))) / 3
        + (E + η + (k : ℝ) * (2 * τ + 1))

name: Nibble.AX1.nu3star_le_cover_of_family_value
statement:
theorem nu3star_le_cover_of_family_value
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (P : Finpartition (univ : Finset V))
    {ep de ep₀ de₀ α τ θ E : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (U W X A B C : ℕ → Finset V)
    (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hgrid : ∀ i < k, IsGridSubTriple G P ep₀ de₀ α τ (U i) (W i) (X i) (A i) (B i) (C i))
    (hval : (∑ p ∈ P.parts.offDiag.filter (fun p => θ ≤ (G.edgeDensity p.1 p.2 : ℝ)),
              (G.edgeDensity p.1 p.2 : ℝ) * (#p.1 : ℝ) * (#p.2 : ℝ)) / 6
            ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, τ ^ 2 * ((G.edgeDensity (U i) (W i) : ℝ)
                * (G.edgeDensity (U i) (X i) : ℝ) * (G.edgeDensity (W i) (X i) : ℝ))) + E) :
    nu3star (G.regularityReduced P ep de)
      ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k,
          ((G.edgeDensity (U i) (W i) : ℝ) * (#(A i) : ℝ) * (#(B i) : ℝ)
            + (G.edgeDensity (U i) (X i) : ℝ) * (#(A i) : ℝ) * (#(C i) : ℝ)
            + (G.edgeDensity (W i) (X i) : ℝ) * (#(B i) : ℝ) * (#(C i) : ℝ))) / 3
        + (θ * (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ^ 2 / 6 + E + (k : ℝ) * (2 * τ + 1))

    {T T' : Finset (ZMod q)} {j j' : ZMod q} (hT : #T = 3) (hT' : #T' = 3)

    (huT' : u' ∈ T') (hwT' : w' ∈ T') (hxT' : x' ∈ T')
    (huw' : u' ≠ w') (hux' : u' ≠ x') (hwx' : w' ≠ x')

    (hB' : B' ⊆ blk (w', triBlock (∑ v ∈ T', v) w' j'))

statement:
theorem exists_rounding (k : ℕ) (H : Finset (Finset V)) (hk : ∀ t ∈ H, t.card ≤ k)
    (y : Finset V → ℝ) (hy0 : ∀ t ∈ H, 0 ≤ y t) (hy1 : ∀ t ∈ H, y t ≤ 1) :
    ∃ S ⊆ H, (∀ t ∈ H, y t = 1 → t ∈ S) ∧ (∀ t ∈ H, y t = 0 → t ∉ S) ∧
      ∀ x : V, |((S.filter (fun t => x ∈ t)).card : ℝ)

    ∃ S ⊆ H,
      (∀ v : V, |((S.filter (fun T => v ∈ T)).card : ℝ)
          - ∑ T ∈ H.filter (fun T => v ∈ T), y T| ≤ 1 + (r : ℝ) * r) ∧
      (∀ x z : V, |((S.filter (fun T => x ∈ T ∧ z ∈ T)).card : ℝ)
          - ∑ T ∈ H.filter (fun T => x ∈ T ∧ z ∈ T), y T| ≤ 1 + (r : ℝ) * r)

name: Nibble.BeckFiala.exists_step

    (hF : (floating H y).Nonempty) :
    ∃ y' : Finset V → ℝ, (∀ t ∈ H, 0 ≤ y' t) ∧ (∀ t ∈ H, y' t ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ t, t ∉ floating H y → y' t = y t) ∧
      (floating H y').card < (floating H y).card ∧
      (∀ x : V, k < ((floating H y).filter (fun t => x ∈ t)).card →
        ∑ t ∈ H.filter (fun t => x ∈ t), y' t = ∑ t ∈ H.filter (fun t => x ∈ t), y t)

lemma exists_left_dummy {U : Finset (Pad X m)} (hU : U ∈ padFam K m) (hR : U.toRight ≠ ∅) :
    ∃ i : Fin m, (Sum.inr (i, false) : Pad X m) ∈ U

name: Nibble.Slack.exists_matching_of_padMatching
statement:
lemma exists_matching_of_padMatching {M : Finset (Finset (Pad X m))}
    (hM : IsMatching (padFam K m) M) :
    ∃ M' : Finset (Finset X), IsMatching K M' ∧
      (M'.card : ℝ) = ((M.filter (fun U => U.toRight = ∅)).card : ℝ)

name: Nibble.Slack.mem_mixTriple_inl
statement:
lemma mem_mixTriple_inl (v u : X) (i j : Fin m) :
    (Sum.inl u : Pad X m) ∈ mixTriple m v i j ↔ u = v

name: Nibble.Slack.mem_mixTriple_inr
statement:
lemma mem_mixTriple_inr (v : X) (i j : Fin m) (d : Fin m × Bool) :
    (Sum.inr d : Pad X m) ∈ mixTriple m v i j ↔ d = (i, false) ∨ d = (j, true)

name: Nibble.Slack.mem_padFam_of_toRight_empty
statement:
lemma mem_padFam_of_toRight_empty {U : Finset (Pad X m)} (hU : U ∈ padFam K m)
    (hR : U.toRight = ∅) : U.toLeft ∈ K ∧ U = U.toLeft.image Sum.inl

name: Nibble.Slack.mixTriple_card
statement: lemma mixTriple_card (v : X) (i j : Fin m) : (mixTriple m v i j).card = 3

name: Nibble.Slack.mixTriple_inj
statement:
lemma mixTriple_inj {v v' : X} {i i' j j' : Fin m}
    (h : mixTriple m v i j = mixTriple m v' i' j') : v = v' ∧ i = i' ∧ j = j'

name: Nibble.Slack.mixTriple_toLeft
statement:
@[simp] lemma mixTriple_toLeft (v : X) (i j : Fin m) :
    (mixTriple m v i j).toLeft = {v}

name: Nibble.Slack.mixTriple_toRight
statement:
@[simp] lemma mixTriple_toRight (v : X) (i j : Fin m) :
    (mixTriple m v i j).toRight = {(i, false), (j, true)}

name: Nibble.Slack.padCodeg_comm
statement:
lemma padCodeg_comm (x z : Pad X m) :
    ∑ U ∈ (padFam K m).filter (fun U => x ∈ U ∧ z ∈ U), padWt K w m U
      = ∑ U ∈ (padFam K m).filter (fun U => z ∈ U ∧ x ∈ U), padWt K w m U

name: Nibble.Slack.padCodeg_inl_inl
statement:
lemma padCodeg_inl_inl {v v' : X} (hvv : v ≠ v') :
    ∑ U ∈ (padFam K m).filter
        (fun U => (Sum.inl v : Pad X m) ∈ U ∧ (Sum.inl v' : Pad X m) ∈ U), padWt K w m U
      = ∑ T ∈ K.filter (fun T => v ∈ T ∧ v' ∈ T), w T

name: Nibble.Slack.padCodeg_inl_inr
statement:
lemma padCodeg_inl_inr (hm : 0 < m) (v : X) (d : Fin m × Bool) :
    ∑ U ∈ (padFam K m).filter
        (fun U => (Sum.inl v : Pad X m) ∈ U ∧ (Sum.inr d : Pad X m) ∈ U), padWt K w m U
      = (1 - wLoad K w v) / (m : ℝ)

name: Nibble.Slack.padCodeg_inr_inr
statement:
lemma padCodeg_inr_inr (hm : 0 < m) (hload : ∀ v : X, wLoad K w v ≤ 1) {d d' : Fin m × Bool}
    (hd : d ≠ d') :
    ∑ U ∈ (padFam K m).filter
        (fun U => (Sum.inr d : Pad X m) ∈ U ∧ (Sum.inr d' : Pad X m) ∈ U), padWt K w m U
      ≤ slackTotal K w / (m : ℝ) ^ 2

name: Nibble.Slack.padFam_uniform
statement: lemma padFam_uniform (hK : IsUniform K 3) : IsUniform (padFam K m) 3

name: Nibble.Slack.padLoad_inl
statement:
lemma padLoad_inl (hm : 0 < m) (v : X) :
    ∑ U ∈ (padFam K m).filter (fun U => (Sum.inl v : Pad X m) ∈ U), padWt K w m U = 1

name: Nibble.Slack.padLoad_inr
statement:
lemma padLoad_inr (hm : 0 < m) (d : Fin m × Bool) :
    ∑ U ∈ (padFam K m).filter (fun U => (Sum.inr d : Pad X m) ∈ U), padWt K w m U
      = slackTotal K w / (m : ℝ)

name: Nibble.Slack.padWt_image_inl
statement: lemma padWt_image_inl (T : Finset X) : padWt K w m (T.image Sum.inl) = w T

name: Nibble.Slack.padWt_mixTriple
statement:
lemma padWt_mixTriple (v : X) (i j : Fin m) :
    padWt K w m (mixTriple m v i j) = (1 - wLoad K w v) / (m : ℝ) ^ 2

name: Nibble.Slack.padWt_nonneg
statement:
lemma padWt_nonneg (hw : ∀ T, 0 ≤ w T) (hload : ∀ v : X, wLoad K w v ≤ 1) (U : Finset (Pad X m)) :
    0 ≤ padWt K w m U

name: Nibble.Slack.slackTotal_nonneg
statement: lemma slackTotal_nonneg (hload : ∀ v : X, wLoad K w v ≤ 1) : 0 ≤ slackTotal K w

name: Nibble.Slack.sum_padFam
statement:
lemma sum_padFam (f : Finset (Pad X m) → ℝ) :
    ∑ U ∈ padFam K m, f U
      = (∑ T ∈ K, f (T.image Sum.inl))
        + ∑ v : X, ∑ i : Fin m, ∑ j : Fin m, f (mixTriple m v i j)

name: Nibble.Slack.sum_padWt
statement:
lemma sum_padWt (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∑ U ∈ padFam K m, padWt K w m U = (∑ T ∈ K, w T) + slackTotal K w

name: Nibble.Slack.sum_wLoad
statement: lemma sum_wLoad (h3 : IsUniform K 3) : ∑ x : X, wLoad K w x = 3 * ∑ T ∈ K, w T

name: Nibble.Slack.toLeft_image_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma toLeft_image_inl (T : Finset X) :
    (T.image (Sum.inl : X → Pad X m)).toLeft = T

name: Nibble.Slack.toRight_image_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma toRight_image_inl (T : Finset X) :
    (T.image (Sum.inl : X → Pad X m)).toRight = (∅ : Finset (Fin m × Bool))

name: Nibble.fracNibble_spread_codegree
statement:
theorem fracNibble_spread_codegree (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∃ γ : ℝ, 0 < γ ∧ ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
      ∀ {W : Type} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] (H : Finset (Finset W)) (w : Finset W → ℝ)
        (Exc : Finset W),
        IsUniform H r →
        (∀ x z : W, x ≠ z → (codegree H x z : ℝ) ≤ C) →
        (∀ T, 0 ≤ w T) →
        (∀ T ∈ H, w T ≤ δ) →
        (∀ v : W, ∑ T ∈ H.filter (fun T => v ∈ T), w T ≤ 1) →
        (∀ v : W, v ∉ Exc → 1 - γ ≤ ∑ T ∈ H.filter (fun T => v ∈ T), w T) →
        (Exc.card : ℝ) ≤ η * (Fintype.card W : ℝ) →
        ∃ M : Finset (Finset W), IsMatching H M ∧
          (1 - β) * ((Fintype.card W : ℝ) / r) ≤ (M.card : ℝ) ∧
          (1 - β) * (∑ T ∈ H, w T) ≤ (M.card : ℝ)

name: Nibble.fracNibble_spread_weightedCodegree
statement:
theorem fracNibble_spread_weightedCodegree (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∃ γ : ℝ, 0 < γ ∧ ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
      ∀ {W : Type} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] (H : Finset (Finset W)) (w : Finset W → ℝ)
        (Exc : Finset W),
        IsUniform H r →
        (∀ T, 0 ≤ w T) →
        (∀ T ∈ H, w T ≤ δ) →
        (∀ v : W, ∑ T ∈ H.filter (fun T => v ∈ T), w T ≤ 1) →
        (∀ v : W, v ∉ Exc → 1 - γ ≤ ∑ T ∈ H.filter (fun T => v ∈ T), w T) →
        (Exc.card : ℝ) ≤ η * (Fintype.card W : ℝ) →
        (∀ x z : W, x ≠ z → ∑ T ∈ H.filter (fun T => x ∈ T ∧ z ∈ T), w T ≤ γ) →
        ∃ M : Finset (Finset W), IsMatching H M ∧
          (1 - β) * ((Fintype.card W : ℝ) / r) ≤ (M.card : ℝ) ∧
          (1 - β) * (∑ T ∈ H, w T) ≤ (M.card : ℝ)

name: Nibble.fracNibble_weightedCodegree
statement:
theorem fracNibble_weightedCodegree (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) :
    ∃ γ : ℝ, 0 < γ ∧ ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
      ∀ {W : Type} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] (H : Finset (Finset W)) (w : Finset W → ℝ)
        (Exc : Finset W),
        IsUniform H r →
        (∀ T, 0 ≤ w T) →
        (∀ v : W, ∑ T ∈ H.filter (fun T => v ∈ T), w T ≤ 1) →
        (∀ v : W, v ∉ Exc → 1 - γ ≤ ∑ T ∈ H.filter (fun T => v ∈ T), w T) →
        (Exc.card : ℝ) ≤ η * (Fintype.card W : ℝ) →
        (∀ x z : W, x ≠ z → ∑ T ∈ H.filter (fun T => x ∈ T ∧ z ∈ T), w T ≤ γ) →
        ∃ M : Finset (Finset W), IsMatching H M ∧
          (1 - β) * ((Fintype.card W : ℝ) / r) ≤ (M.card : ℝ) ∧
          (1 - β) * (∑ T ∈ H, w T) ≤ (M.card : ℝ)

name: Nibble.weight_le_weightedCodegree
statement:
theorem weight_le_weightedCodegree {W : Type} [DecidableEq W] {r : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    {H : Finset (Finset W)} {w : Finset W → ℝ} {γ : ℝ} (hunif : IsUniform H r)
    (hwnn : ∀ T, 0 ≤ w T)
    (hcod : ∀ x z : W, x ≠ z → ∑ T ∈ H.filter (fun T => x ∈ T ∧ z ∈ T), w T ≤ γ)

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxCount.card_one
statement:
theorem card_one (huP : ∀ a, u a ≤ P) (p : ZMod 3) (i : Fin P) :
    #((plc P u).filter (fun A => i ∈ A p)) * P = u p * #(plc P u)

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxCount.card_plc_pos
statement: theorem card_plc_pos (huP : ∀ a, u a ≤ P) : 0 < #(plc P u)

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxCount.card_plc_prod
statement:
theorem card_plc_prod {p q t : ZMod 3} (hpq : p ≠ q) (hpt : p ≠ t) (hqt : q ≠ t) :
    #(plc P u) = #(subs P (u p)) * #(subs P (u q)) * #(subs P (u t))

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxCount.card_plc_req
statement:
theorem card_plc_req (req : ZMod 3 → Finset (Fin P)) :
    #((plc P u).filter (fun A => ∀ a, req a ⊆ A a))
      = ∏ a : ZMod 3, #((subs P (u a)).filter (fun A => req a ⊆ A))

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxCount.card_plc_three
statement:
theorem card_plc_three {p q t : ZMod 3} (hpq : p ≠ q) (hpt : p ≠ t) (hqt : q ≠ t)
    (Bp Bq Bt : Finset (Fin P)) :
    #((plc P u).filter (fun A => Bp ⊆ A p ∧ Bq ⊆ A q ∧ Bt ⊆ A t))
      = #((subs P (u p)).filter (fun A => Bp ⊆ A)) * #((subs P (u q)).filter (fun A => Bq ⊆ A))
        * #((subs P (u t)).filter (fun A => Bt ⊆ A))

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxCount.card_subs
statement: theorem card_subs (P u : ℕ) : #(subs P u) = Nat.choose P u

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxCount.card_subs_req
statement:
theorem card_subs_req {u : ℕ} (B : Finset (Fin P)) (hB : #B ≤ u) :
    #((subs P u).filter (fun A => B ⊆ A)) = Nat.choose (P - #B) (u - #B)

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxCount.card_three
statement:
theorem card_three (huP : ∀ a, u a ≤ P) {p q t : ZMod 3} (hpq : p ≠ q) (hpt : p ≠ t)
    (hqt : q ≠ t) (i j l : Fin P) :
    #((plc P u).filter (fun A => i ∈ A p ∧ j ∈ A q ∧ l ∈ A t)) * (P * P * P)
      = u p * u q * u t * #(plc P u)

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxCount.card_two
statement:
theorem card_two (huP : ∀ a, u a ≤ P) {p q : ZMod 3} (hpq : p ≠ q) (i j : Fin P) :
    #((plc P u).filter (fun A => i ∈ A p ∧ j ∈ A q)) * (P * P) = u p * u q * #(plc P u)

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxCount.card_two_one
statement:
theorem card_two_one (huP : ∀ a, u a ≤ P) {p q : ZMod 3} (hpq : p ≠ q) {i i' : Fin P}
    (hii : i ≠ i') (j : Fin P) :
    #((plc P u).filter (fun A => i ∈ A p ∧ i' ∈ A p ∧ j ∈ A q)) * (P * (P - 1) * P)
      = u p * (u p - 1) * u q * #(plc P u)

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxCount.choose_mul_step
statement:
theorem choose_mul_step {n k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    n * Nat.choose (n - 1) (k - 1) = k * Nat.choose n k

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxCount.exists_third
statement: theorem exists_third {p q : ZMod 3} (hpq : p ≠ q) : ∃ t : ZMod 3, p ≠ t ∧ q ≠ t

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxCount.filter_empty_req
statement:
theorem filter_empty_req (v : ℕ) :
    ((subs P v).filter (fun A => (∅ : Finset (Fin P)) ⊆ A)) = subs P v

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxCount.mem_plc
statement: theorem mem_plc {A : ZMod 3 → Finset (Fin P)} : A ∈ plc P u ↔ ∀ a, #(A a) = u a

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxCount.mem_subs
statement: theorem mem_subs {u : ℕ} {A : Finset (Fin P)} : A ∈ subs P u ↔ #A = u

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxCount.mem_three
statement:
theorem mem_three {p q t : ZMod 3} (hpq : p ≠ q) (hpt : p ≠ t) (hqt : q ≠ t) (a : ZMod 3) :

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxCount.prod_three
statement:
theorem prod_three {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (f : ZMod 3 → M) {p q t : ZMod 3} (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (hpt : p ≠ t) (hqt : q ≠ t) : ∏ a : ZMod 3, f a = f p * f q * f t

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxCount.subs_one_mul
statement:
theorem subs_one_mul {u : ℕ} (huP : u ≤ P) (i : Fin P) :
    #((subs P u).filter (fun A => ({i} : Finset (Fin P)) ⊆ A)) * P = u * #(subs P u)

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxCount.subs_two_mul
statement:
theorem subs_two_mul {u : ℕ} (huP : u ≤ P) {i i' : Fin P} (hii : i ≠ i') :
    #((subs P u).filter (fun A => ({i, i'} : Finset (Fin P)) ⊆ A)) * (P * (P - 1))
      = u * (u - 1) * #(subs P u)

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxCount.succ_ne_self

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxCount.univ_eq_three

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxPlace.boxDemandC_nonneg

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxPlace.card_copies_le
statement:
theorem card_copies_le {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hcl : ∀ c, Function.Injective (cl c))
    (hsz1 : ∀ c a, 1 ≤ sz c a)
    (hdem : ∀ S T : ι, S ≠ T → boxDemand cl sz S T ≤ (1 - ε) * (P : ℝ) ^ 2) :
    (Fintype.card κ : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) ^ 2 * (P : ℝ) ^ 2

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxPlace.codeg_inl_inl_le
statement:
theorem codeg_inl_inl_le (hP : 2 ≤ P) {s₀ : ℕ} (hs : ∀ c a, sz c a ≤ s₀) {S T S' T' : ι}
    {i j i' j' : Fin P} (hne : (S, T, i, j) ≠ (S', T', i', j')) :
    ∑ U ∈ ((placeFam P idx cl sz).filter
          (fun U => (Sum.inl (S, T, i, j) : PlaceVtx ι κ P) ∈ U)).filter
        (fun U => (Sum.inl (S', T', i', j') : PlaceVtx ι κ P) ∈ U),
      placeWt P sz U
      ≤ 18 * (s₀ : ℝ) / (P : ℝ) * (boxDemand cl sz S T / (P : ℝ) ^ 2)

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxPlace.codeg_inl_inr_le
statement:
theorem codeg_inl_inr_le (hP : 0 < P) {s₀ : ℕ} (hs : ∀ c a, sz c a ≤ s₀) (c : κ) (S T : ι)
    (i j : Fin P) :
    ∑ U ∈ ((placeFam P idx cl sz).filter
          (fun U => (Sum.inl (S, T, i, j) : PlaceVtx ι κ P) ∈ U)).filter
        (fun U => (Sum.inr c : PlaceVtx ι κ P) ∈ U),
      placeWt P sz U ≤ 9 * (s₀ : ℝ) ^ 2 / (P : ℝ) ^ 2

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxPlace.codeg_inr_inr
statement:
theorem codeg_inr_inr {c c' : κ} (h : c ≠ c') :
    ∑ U ∈ ((placeFam P idx cl sz).filter (fun U => (Sum.inr c : PlaceVtx ι κ P) ∈ U)).filter
        (fun U => (Sum.inr c' : PlaceVtx ι κ P) ∈ U),
      placeWt P sz U = 0

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxPlace.codeg_le
statement:
theorem codeg_le (hP : 2 ≤ P) {s₀ : ℕ} (hs : ∀ c a, sz c a ≤ s₀) (hsP : s₀ ≤ P)
    (hdem : ∀ S T : ι, S ≠ T → boxDemand cl sz S T ≤ (P : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (x z : PlaceVtx ι κ P) (hxz : x ≠ z) :
    ∑ U ∈ ((placeFam P idx cl sz).filter (fun U => x ∈ U)).filter (fun U => z ∈ U),
      placeWt P sz U ≤ 18 * (s₀ : ℝ) / (P : ℝ)

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxPlace.slot_count_core
statement:
theorem slot_count_core (hidx : Function.Injective idx) (hcl : Function.Injective (cl c))
    (hszP : ∀ a, sz c a ≤ P) (hP : 0 < P) (S T : ι) (i j : Fin P)
    {F : Finset (ZMod 3 → Finset (Fin P))} (hFsub : F ⊆ BoxCount.plc P (sz c))
    (hF : ∀ A ∈ F, (Sum.inl (S, T, i, j) : PlaceVtx ι κ P) ∈ placeEdge idx cl c A) :
    F = ∅ ∨ ∃ p q : ZMod 3, p ≠ q ∧ cl c p = S ∧ cl c q = T ∧
      (#F : ℝ) * ((placeCard P sz c : ℝ))⁻¹ ≤ (sz c p : ℝ) * (sz c q : ℝ) / (P : ℝ) ^ 2

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxPlace.slot_count_le_demand
statement:
theorem slot_count_le_demand (hidx : Function.Injective idx) (hcl : Function.Injective (cl c))
    (hszP : ∀ a, sz c a ≤ P) (hP : 0 < P) (S T : ι) (i j : Fin P)
    {F : Finset (ZMod 3 → Finset (Fin P))} (hFsub : F ⊆ BoxCount.plc P (sz c))
    (hF : ∀ A ∈ F, (Sum.inl (S, T, i, j) : PlaceVtx ι κ P) ∈ placeEdge idx cl c A) :
    ∑ _A ∈ F, ((placeCard P sz c : ℝ))⁻¹ ≤ boxDemandC cl sz c S T / (P : ℝ) ^ 2

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxPlace.slot_count_le_sz
statement:
theorem slot_count_le_sz (hidx : Function.Injective idx) (hcl : Function.Injective (cl c))
    (hszP : ∀ a, sz c a ≤ P) (hP : 0 < P) {s₀ : ℕ} (hs : ∀ a, sz c a ≤ s₀) (S T : ι)
    (i j : Fin P) {F : Finset (ZMod 3 → Finset (Fin P))} (hFsub : F ⊆ BoxCount.plc P (sz c))
    (hF : ∀ A ∈ F, (Sum.inl (S, T, i, j) : PlaceVtx ι κ P) ∈ placeEdge idx cl c A) :
    ∑ _A ∈ F, ((placeCard P sz c : ℝ))⁻¹ ≤ (s₀ : ℝ) ^ 2 / (P : ℝ) ^ 2

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxPlace.sum_inv_const
statement:
theorem sum_inv_const (F : Finset (ZMod 3 → Finset (Fin P))) :
    ∑ _A ∈ F, ((placeCard P sz c : ℝ))⁻¹ = (#F : ℝ) * ((placeCard P sz c : ℝ))⁻¹

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxPlace.sum_placeFam
statement:
theorem sum_placeFam (f : Finset (PlaceVtx ι κ P) → ℝ) :
    ∑ U ∈ placeFam P idx cl sz, f U
      = ∑ c : κ, ∑ A ∈ BoxCount.plc P (sz c), f (placeEdge idx cl c A)

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxPlace.sum_placeFam_filter
statement:
theorem sum_placeFam_filter (p : Finset (PlaceVtx ι κ P) → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (f : Finset (PlaceVtx ι κ P) → ℝ) :
    ∑ U ∈ (placeFam P idx cl sz).filter p, f U
      = ∑ c : κ, ∑ A ∈ (BoxCount.plc P (sz c)).filter (fun A => p (placeEdge idx cl c A)),
          f (placeEdge idx cl c A)

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxPlace.sum_placeWt
statement:
theorem sum_placeWt :
    ∑ U ∈ placeFam P idx cl sz, placeWt P sz U = (Fintype.card κ : ℝ)

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxPlace.sz_mul_le_boxDemandC
statement:
theorem sz_mul_le_boxDemandC {c : κ} {p q : ZMod 3} {S T : ι} (hp : cl c p = S) (hq : cl c q = T) :
    (sz c p : ℝ) * (sz c q : ℝ) ≤ boxDemandC cl sz c S T

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxPlace.two_slot_count_le
statement:
theorem two_slot_count_le (hidx : Function.Injective idx) (hcl : Function.Injective (cl c))
    (hszP : ∀ a, sz c a ≤ P) (hP : 2 ≤ P) {s₀ : ℕ} (hs : ∀ a, sz c a ≤ s₀) {S T S' T' : ι}
    {i j i' j' : Fin P} (hne : (S, T, i, j) ≠ (S', T', i', j'))
    {F : Finset (ZMod 3 → Finset (Fin P))} (hFsub : F ⊆ BoxCount.plc P (sz c))
    (hF1 : ∀ A ∈ F, (Sum.inl (S, T, i, j) : PlaceVtx ι κ P) ∈ placeEdge idx cl c A)
    (hF2 : ∀ A ∈ F, (Sum.inl (S', T', i', j') : PlaceVtx ι κ P) ∈ placeEdge idx cl c A) :
    ∑ _A ∈ F, ((placeCard P sz c : ℝ))⁻¹
      ≤ 18 * (s₀ : ℝ) / (P : ℝ) * (boxDemandC cl sz c S T / (P : ℝ) ^ 2)

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxPlace.wLoad_inl_le
statement:
theorem wLoad_inl_le (hP : 0 < P) (S T : ι) (i j : Fin P) :
    Slack.wLoad (placeFam P idx cl sz) (placeWt P sz) (Sum.inl (S, T, i, j))
      ≤ boxDemand cl sz S T / (P : ℝ) ^ 2

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxPlace.wLoad_inl_of_not_lt
statement:
theorem wLoad_inl_of_not_lt {S T : ι} (h : ¬ idx S < idx T) (i j : Fin P) :
    Slack.wLoad (placeFam P idx cl sz) (placeWt P sz) (Sum.inl (S, T, i, j)) = 0

name: Nibble.AX1.BoxPlace.wLoad_inr
statement:
theorem wLoad_inr (c : κ) :
    Slack.wLoad (placeFam P idx cl sz) (placeWt P sz) (Sum.inr c) = 1

name: Nibble.AX1.boxAllocationResidual_main
statement:
theorem boxAllocationResidual_main (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (s₀ : ℕ) :
    ∃ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ ∧ θ ≤ 1 ∧
      ∀ P : ℕ, 0 < P → (s₀ : ℝ) ≤ θ * (P : ℝ) →
      ∀ (ι κ : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
        (cl : κ → ZMod 3 → ι) (sz : κ → ZMod 3 → ℕ),
        (∀ c, Function.Injective (cl c)) →
        (∀ c a, 1 ≤ sz c a) → (∀ c a, sz c a ≤ s₀) →
        (∀ S T : ι, S ≠ T → boxDemand cl sz S T ≤ (1 - ε) * (P : ℝ) ^ 2) →
        ∃ (bad : Finset κ) (I : κ → ZMod 3 → Finset (Fin P)),
          (∀ c a, #(I c a) = sz c a) ∧
          (∀ c ∉ bad, ∀ c' ∉ bad, c ≠ c' → ∀ a b a' b' : ZMod 3, a ≠ b → a' ≠ b' →
            cl c a = cl c' a' → cl c b = cl c' b' →
            Disjoint (I c a) (I c' a') ∨ Disjoint (I c b) (I c' b')) ∧
          (∑ c ∈ bad, ∑ a : ZMod 3, (sz c a : ℝ) * (sz c (a + 1) : ℝ))
            ≤ ε * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) ^ 2 * (P : ℝ) ^ 2

name: Nibble.AX1.card_rect
statement: theorem card_rect (a : ZMod 3) : #(rect idx cl c A a) = #(A a) * #(A (a + 1))

name: Nibble.AX1.inr_notMem_rect
statement:
theorem inr_notMem_rect {a : ZMod 3} {c' : κ} :
    (Sum.inr c' : PlaceVtx ι κ P) ∉ rect idx cl c A a

name: Nibble.AX1.mem_placeEdge_iff
statement:
theorem mem_placeEdge_iff (hidx : Function.Injective idx) (hcl : Function.Injective (cl c))
    {p q : ZMod 3} (hpq : p ≠ q) (i j : Fin P) :
    (Sum.inl (orient idx (cl c p) (cl c q) i j) : PlaceVtx ι κ P) ∈ placeEdge idx cl c A ↔
      i ∈ A p ∧ j ∈ A q

name: Nibble.AX1.mem_placeEdge_inl
statement:
theorem mem_placeEdge_inl (hidx : Function.Injective idx) (hcl : Function.Injective (cl c))
    (S T : ι) (i j : Fin P) :
    (Sum.inl (S, T, i, j) : PlaceVtx ι κ P) ∈ placeEdge idx cl c A ↔
      ∃ p q : ZMod 3, p ≠ q ∧ cl c p = S ∧ cl c q = T ∧ idx S < idx T ∧ i ∈ A p ∧ j ∈ A q

name: Nibble.AX1.mem_placeEdge_inr
statement:
theorem mem_placeEdge_inr (c' : κ) :
    (Sum.inr c' : PlaceVtx ι κ P) ∈ placeEdge idx cl c A ↔ c' = c

name: Nibble.AX1.mem_placeEdge_orient
statement:
theorem mem_placeEdge_orient (hidx : Function.Injective idx) (hcl : Function.Injective (cl c))
    {p q : ZMod 3} (hpq : p ≠ q) {i j : Fin P} (hi : i ∈ A p) (hj : j ∈ A q) :
    (Sum.inl (orient idx (cl c p) (cl c q) i j) : PlaceVtx ι κ P) ∈ placeEdge idx cl c A

name: Nibble.AX1.mem_rect
statement:
theorem mem_rect {a : ZMod 3} {x : Slot ι P} :
    (Sum.inl x : PlaceVtx ι κ P) ∈ rect idx cl c A a ↔
      ∃ i ∈ A a, ∃ j ∈ A (a + 1), orient idx (cl c a) (cl c (a + 1)) i j = x

statement: theorem nibbleGapHyp_holds : NibbleGapHyp

statement:

name: Nibble.AX1.orient_symm
statement:
theorem orient_symm {S T : ι} (h : idx S ≠ idx T) (i j : Fin P) :
    orient idx T S j i = orient idx S T i j

name: Nibble.AX1.placeEdge_card
statement:
theorem placeEdge_card (hcl : Function.Injective (cl c)) :
    #(placeEdge idx cl c A) = 1 + ∑ a : ZMod 3, #(A a) * #(A (a + 1))

name: Nibble.AX1.placeEdge_inj
statement:
theorem placeEdge_inj (hidx : Function.Injective idx) (hcl : Function.Injective (cl c))
    {c' : κ} {A' : ZMod 3 → Finset (Fin P)} (hcl' : Function.Injective (cl c'))
    (hA : ∀ a, (A a).Nonempty) (hA' : ∀ a, (A' a).Nonempty)
    (h : placeEdge idx cl c A = placeEdge idx cl c' A') : c = c' ∧ A = A'

name: Nibble.AX1.placeEdge_toRight
statement: theorem placeEdge_toRight : (placeEdge idx cl c A).toRight = {c}

name: Nibble.AX1.rect_disjoint
statement:
theorem rect_disjoint (hcl : Function.Injective (cl c)) {a b : ZMod 3} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Disjoint (rect idx cl c A a) (rect idx cl c A b)

name: Nibble.AX1.zmod3_consec
statement: theorem zmod3_consec {p q : ZMod 3} (hpq : p ≠ q) : q = p + 1 ∨ p = q + 1

name: Nibble.AX1.zmod3_pair_ne
statement:
theorem zmod3_pair_ne {a b : ZMod 3} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    ¬ ((a = b ∧ a + 1 = b + 1) ∨ (a = b + 1 ∧ a + 1 = b))
